```{r null-evidence-helpers}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# NULL-INFERENCE INFRASTRUCTURE
# Purpose: distinguish credible positive effects, absence-of-evidence nulls,
#   design-constrained untestable effects, and measurement-limited inconclusive
#   effects using a graded-evidence framework.
#
# ROPE CONSTANTS (project convention; multiple scripts: generate_effect_contrasts_from_run.R,
#   extract_params_and_contrasts.R, table_effect_contrasts.R).
# These are NOT published SESOI anchors.  They are the minimum "practically
# negligible" bounds used throughout this project's analysis pipeline.
# Interpretation is therefore GRADED ("consistent with at most a small effect")
# NOT "practically equivalent to zero."  A formal equivalence test would require
# a pre-registered SESOI from prior DDM literature — none exists for this
# exact paradigm and population.  See classify_null_evidence() for labels.
#
# ROPE sources:
#   rope_v    = 0.02  — identity link; ≈ 2% of Wiener noise SD (σ=1)
#   rope_bs   = 0.05  — log link;      exp(0.05)−1 ≈ 5.1% change in boundary
#   rope_bias = 0.05  — logit link;    ≈ ±0.0125 change in z (prob. scale)
#   rope_ndt  = 0.02  — log link;      exp(0.02)−1 ≈ 2.0% change in NDT
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ROPE_V    <- 0.02    # drift (identity link)
ROPE_BS   <- 0.05    # boundary separation (log link)
ROPE_BIAS <- 0.05    # bias (logit link)
ROPE_NDT  <- 0.02    # non-decision time (log link)

# Z-scale (probability) equivalent of ROPE_BIAS (logit scale).
# inv_logit(0.05) − 0.5 = 0.5125 − 0.5 = 0.0125
# Used when H4 contrasts are stored as Δz on the probability scale (0–1),
# not on the logit scale used internally by brms.
ROPE_BIAS_Z <- round(plogis(ROPE_BIAS) - 0.5, 5)   # ≈ 0.01250

# ── Gaussian approximation helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────

# Estimate posterior SD from symmetric 95% CrI (normal approximation).
cri_to_sd <- function(q2.5, q97.5) {
  if (any(is.na(c(q2.5, q97.5)))) return(NA_real_)
  (q97.5 - q2.5) / (2 * qnorm(0.975))
}

# Proportion of Gaussian(estimate, sd) inside symmetric ROPE [-rope, +rope].
p_in_rope_gauss <- function(estimate, q2.5, q97.5, rope_half_width) {
  if (any(is.na(c(estimate, q2.5, q97.5, rope_half_width)))) return(NA_real_)
  if (rope_half_width <= 0) return(0)
  sd_est <- cri_to_sd(q2.5, q97.5)
  if (is.na(sd_est) || sd_est <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  pnorm(rope_half_width,  mean = estimate, sd = sd_est) -
  pnorm(-rope_half_width, mean = estimate, sd = sd_est)
}

# Approximate P(beta > 0) from Gaussian summary if not directly available.
p_gt0_gauss <- function(estimate, q2.5, q97.5) {
  if (any(is.na(c(estimate, q2.5, q97.5)))) return(NA_real_)
  sd_est <- cri_to_sd(q2.5, q97.5)
  if (is.na(sd_est) || sd_est <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  pnorm(0, mean = estimate, sd = sd_est, lower.tail = FALSE)
}

# ── Core posterior summary row builder ─────────────────────────────────────

summarize_posterior_effect <- function(
    label, parameter,
    estimate, q2.5, q97.5,
    p_gt0           = NA_real_,
    rope_half_width = NA_real_,
    design_limited  = FALSE,
    meas_limited    = FALSE,
    scale_note      = "") {

  ci_includes_zero <- !is.na(q2.5) && !is.na(q97.5) &&
                      (q2.5 <= 0) && (q97.5 >= 0)
  cri_width <- if (!any(is.na(c(q2.5, q97.5)))) q97.5 - q2.5 else NA_real_

  p_in  <- p_in_rope_gauss(estimate, q2.5, q97.5, rope_half_width)
  p_out <- if (!is.na(p_in)) 1 - p_in else NA_real_

  # If P(β>0) not provided, approximate from Gaussian CrI
  if (is.na(p_gt0) && !is.na(estimate) && !is.na(q2.5) && !is.na(q97.5)) {
    p_gt0 <- p_gt0_gauss(estimate, q2.5, q97.5)
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    label             = label,
    parameter         = parameter,
    estimate          = estimate,
    q2.5              = q2.5,
    q97.5             = q97.5,
    cri_width         = cri_width,
    ci_includes_zero  = ci_includes_zero,
    p_gt0             = p_gt0,
    rope_half_width   = rope_half_width,
    p_in_rope         = p_in,
    p_outside_rope    = p_out,
    design_limited    = design_limited,
    meas_limited      = meas_limited,
    scale_note        = scale_note
  )
}

# ── Graded evidence classifier ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Returns one of four labels; ROPE classification uses project convention
# (NOT formal equivalence).  H3 is always design-constrained.  Pupil effects
# are always measurement-limited.
classify_null_evidence <- function(row) {
  if (isTRUE(row$design_limited))
    return("design-constrained / not directly testable")
  if (isTRUE(row$meas_limited))
    return("measurement-limited / inconclusive")

  q2  <- row$q2.5
  q97 <- row$q97.5
  if (!is.na(q2) && !is.na(q97)) {
    if (q97 < 0) return("credible negative effect")
    if (q2  > 0) return("credible positive effect")
  }

  # CrI includes zero: grade by ROPE mass
  p_in <- row$p_in_rope
  if (!is.na(p_in)) {
    if (p_in >= 0.90)
      return("estimate near zero; ≥90% posterior mass within project ROPE")
    if (p_in >= 0.75)
      return("estimate near zero; majority of posterior within project ROPE")
  }
  "no credible evidence of effect (CrI spans zero)"
}

# ── Safe wrapper: build row + attach label ───────────────────────────────────
safe_rope_summary <- function(
    label, parameter,
    estimate, q2.5, q97.5,
    p_gt0           = NA_real_,
    rope_half_width = NA_real_,
    design_limited  = FALSE,
    meas_limited    = FALSE,
    scale_note      = "") {

  row <- tryCatch(
    summarize_posterior_effect(
      label = label, parameter = parameter,
      estimate = estimate, q2.5 = q2.5, q97.5 = q97.5,
      p_gt0 = p_gt0, rope_half_width = rope_half_width,
      design_limited = design_limited, meas_limited = meas_limited,
      scale_note = scale_note),
    error = function(e) {
      tibble::tibble(
        label = label, parameter = parameter,
        estimate = NA_real_, q2.5 = NA_real_, q97.5 = NA_real_,
        cri_width = NA_real_, ci_includes_zero = NA,
        p_gt0 = NA_real_, rope_half_width = rope_half_width,
        p_in_rope = NA_real_, p_outside_rope = NA_real_,
        design_limited = design_limited, meas_limited = meas_limited,
        scale_note = scale_note)
    })
  row$evidence_label <- tryCatch(classify_null_evidence(row), error = function(e) "classification error")
  row
}

# ── Display formatter ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Note: column names use ASCII internally; the caller can rename for display.
format_posterior_summary <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Estimate    = dplyr::if_else(is.na(estimate), "--",
                     sprintf("%.3f", estimate)),
      CrI95       = dplyr::if_else(is.na(q2.5) | is.na(q97.5), "--",
                     sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", q2.5, q97.5)),
      P_gt0_fmt   = dplyr::case_when(
                     is.na(p_gt0)      ~ "--",
                     p_gt0 >= 0.999    ~ "> .999",
                     p_gt0 <= 0.001    ~ "< .001",
                     TRUE              ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_gt0)),
      P_rope_fmt  = dplyr::case_when(
                     design_limited | meas_limited ~ "n/a",
                     is.na(p_in_rope)  ~ "--",
                     TRUE              ~ sprintf("%.2f", p_in_rope)),
      Evidence    = evidence_label
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(label, parameter, Estimate, CrI95,
                  P_gt0_fmt, P_rope_fmt, Evidence, scale_note) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      Effect         = label,
      Parameter      = parameter,
      `95% CrI`      = CrI95,
      `P(beta>0)`    = P_gt0_fmt,
      `P(in ROPE)`   = P_rope_fmt
    )
}

# ── Application: H2, H3, H4 (all values available at this point) ────────────
# NOTE: do NOT apply to pupil effects here — pd_est/pb_est/q_std etc. are
# defined in later chunks (pupil-evidence-setup, pupil-interaction-stats).
# Pupil application is in chunk null-evidence-pupil-apply (after those chunks).

null_ev_h2 <- safe_rope_summary(
  label           = "H2: Effort → Boundary Separation",
  parameter       = "bs (log link)",
  estimate        = if (exists("h2_est") && !is.null(h2_est)) h2_est else NA_real_,
  q2.5            = if (exists("h2_lo")  && !is.null(h2_lo))  h2_lo  else NA_real_,
  q97.5           = if (exists("h2_hi")  && !is.null(h2_hi))  h2_hi  else NA_real_,
  p_gt0           = NA_real_,   # no h2_p0 object; will be approximated inside helper
  rope_half_width = ROPE_BS,
  design_limited  = FALSE,
  meas_limited    = FALSE,
  scale_note      = paste0("Log link. ROPE = ±", ROPE_BS,
                           " (project convention; exp(0.05)−1 ≈ 5.1% change in boundary)")
)

null_ev_h3 <- safe_rope_summary(
  label           = "H3: Effort → Non-Decision Time (exploratory only)",
  parameter       = "ndt (log link)",
  estimate        =  0.02,   # hardcoded from exploratory model (h3_beta_str)
  q2.5            = -0.05,   # hardcoded from h3_cri_str
  q97.5           =  0.09,
  p_gt0           = NA_real_,
  rope_half_width = ROPE_NDT,
  design_limited  = TRUE,    # t0 intercept-only by design; H3 is untestable
  meas_limited    = FALSE,
  scale_note      = paste0("DESIGN-CONSTRAINED: t0 forced to intercept-only for ",
                           "response-signal stability. Exploratory estimate only; ",
                           "cannot be interpreted as an informative null for H3.")
)

null_ev_h4 <- safe_rope_summary(
  label           = "H4: Effort → Starting-Point Bias",
  parameter       = "z (logit link)",
  estimate        = if (exists("h4_est") && !is.null(h4_est)) h4_est else NA_real_,
  q2.5            = if (exists("h4_lo")  && !is.null(h4_lo))  h4_lo  else NA_real_,
  q97.5           = if (exists("h4_hi")  && !is.null(h4_hi))  h4_hi  else NA_real_,
  p_gt0           = if (exists("h4_p0_val") && !is.na(h4_p0_val)) h4_p0_val else NA_real_,  # P(beta > 0)
  rope_half_width = ROPE_BIAS,
  design_limited  = FALSE,
  meas_limited    = FALSE,
  scale_note      = paste0("Primary additive model; logit link. ROPE = ±", ROPE_BIAS,
                           " (project convention). Standard-only Δz in Appendix A2.")
)

# Convenience inline strings for H2 and H4
h2_evidence_label <- null_ev_h2$evidence_label %||% "no credible evidence of effect (CrI spans zero)"
h2_p_in_rope_pct  <- if (!is.na(null_ev_h2$p_in_rope))
                       sprintf("%.0f%%", null_ev_h2$p_in_rope * 100) else "–"
h2_rope_practically_null <- !is.na(null_ev_h2$p_in_rope) && null_ev_h2$p_in_rope >= 0.99
if (h2_rope_practically_null) {
  h2_evidence_label <-
    "directionally positive; practically equivalent to zero under project ROPE"
  null_ev_h2$evidence_label <- h2_evidence_label
}

h4_evidence_label <- null_ev_h4$evidence_label %||% "no credible evidence of effect (CrI spans zero)"
h4_p_in_rope_pct  <- if (!is.na(null_ev_h4$p_in_rope))
                       sprintf("%.0f%%", null_ev_h4$p_in_rope * 100) else "–"

# Partial summary table (H2–H4 only; pupil rows appended in null-evidence-pupil-apply)
null_evidence_h_partial <- dplyr::bind_rows(null_ev_h2, null_ev_h3, null_ev_h4)

# ── H1: for unified hypothesis summary table ───────────────────────────────
null_ev_h1 <- safe_rope_summary(
  label           = "H1: Effort → Drift Rate",
  parameter       = "v (identity link)",
  estimate        = if (exists("h1_est") && !is.null(h1_est)) h1_est else NA_real_,
  q2.5            = if (exists("h1_lo")  && !is.null(h1_lo))  h1_lo  else NA_real_,
  q97.5           = if (exists("h1_hi")  && !is.null(h1_hi))  h1_hi  else NA_real_,
  p_gt0           = {
    # h1_p0_val = P(beta < 0); convert to P(beta > 0) for column consistency
    if (exists("h1_p0_val") && !is.na(h1_p0_val)) 1 - h1_p0_val else NA_real_
  },
  rope_half_width = ROPE_V,
  design_limited  = FALSE,
  meas_limited    = FALSE,
  scale_note      = "Supported: CrI excludes zero (both bounds negative); High effort reliably reduces drift."
)
h1_p_in_rope_pct <- if (!is.na(null_ev_h1$p_in_rope))
  sprintf("%.0f%%", null_ev_h1$p_in_rope * 100) else "—"

# ── Early-load pooled pupil effects from CSV ──────────────────────────────────
# Loaded here so the unified table (tbl-hyp-summary) can display pooled pupil
# estimates even though the full pupil section renders later in the document.
# Conditional slope values are NOT available at this point; those rows carry NAs.
.pkt_loaded <- FALSE
.pd_est_e <- NA_real_; .pd_lo_e <- NA_real_; .pd_hi_e <- NA_real_
.pb_est_e <- NA_real_; .pb_lo_e <- NA_real_; .pb_hi_e <- NA_real_

for (.pcf in c(
    file.path(proj_root, "output", "pupil_ddm", "tables", "pupil_effects_key_terms.csv"),
    file.path(proj_root, "output", "ddm_pupil", "tables", "pupil_effects_key_terms.csv"),
    file.path(proj_root, params$run_dir, "tables", "pupil_effects_key_terms.csv")
  )) {
  if (!file.exists(.pcf)) next
  .pkt <- readr::read_csv(.pcf, show_col_types = FALSE)
  .ec  <- intersect(c("Estimate","estimate","mean"), names(.pkt))[1]
  .q2c <- intersect(c("Q2.5","q2.5"), names(.pkt))[1]
  .q9c <- intersect(c("Q97.5","q97.5"), names(.pkt))[1]
  .tc  <- intersect(c("term","parameter","Parameter"), names(.pkt))[1]
  if (!is.na(.ec) && !is.na(.tc)) {
    if ("dpar" %in% names(.pkt)) {
      .dr <- .pkt %>%
        dplyr::filter(.data$dpar == "v",
                      grepl("pupil|tepr|auc", .data[[.tc]], ignore.case = TRUE),
                      !grepl(":", .data[[.tc]])) %>%
        { if ("model" %in% names(.pkt)) dplyr::filter(., grepl("model_2", .data$model)) else . } %>%
        dplyr::slice(1)
      .br <- .pkt %>%
        dplyr::filter(.data$dpar == "bias",
                      grepl("pupil|tepr|auc", .data[[.tc]], ignore.case = TRUE),
                      !grepl(":", .data[[.tc]])) %>%
        { if ("model" %in% names(.pkt)) dplyr::filter(., grepl("model_1", .data$model)) else . } %>%
        dplyr::slice(1)
    } else {
      .dr <- .pkt %>%
        dplyr::filter(!grepl("^bs_|^bias_|^ndt_", .data[[.tc]], ignore.case = TRUE),
                      grepl("pupil|tepr|auc", .data[[.tc]], ignore.case = TRUE),
                      !grepl(":", .data[[.tc]])) %>%
        dplyr::slice(1)
      .br <- .pkt %>%
        dplyr::filter(grepl("^bias_", .data[[.tc]], ignore.case = TRUE),
                      grepl("pupil|tepr|auc", .data[[.tc]], ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
        dplyr::slice(1)
    }
    if (nrow(.dr) == 1) {
      .pd_est_e <- .dr[[.ec]]; .pd_lo_e <- .dr[[.q2c]]; .pd_hi_e <- .dr[[.q9c]]
    }
    if (nrow(.br) == 1) {
      .pb_est_e <- .br[[.ec]]; .pb_lo_e <- .br[[.q2c]]; .pb_hi_e <- .br[[.q9c]]
    }
    .pkt_loaded <- TRUE
  }
  rm(.pkt, .dr, .br, .ec, .q2c, .q9c, .tc)
  break
}
rm(.pcf)

# ── Pupil LOO diagnostics (inline prose; Table 18 / appendix) ────────────────
pupil_loo_max_k <- NA_real_
pupil_loo_delta_m1 <- pupil_loo_delta_m2 <- pupil_loo_delta_m3 <- NA_real_
for (.plf in c(
    file.path(proj_root, "output", "ddm_pupil", "tables", "pupil_loo_summary.csv"),
    file.path(proj_root, "output", "pupil_ddm", "tables", "pupil_loo_summary.csv")
  )) {
  if (!file.exists(.plf)) next
  .ploo <- readr::read_csv(.plf, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if ("pareto_k_max" %in% names(.ploo)) {
    pupil_loo_max_k <- max(.ploo$pareto_k_max, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  if ("delta_elpd_vs_m0" %in% names(.ploo) && "model_name" %in% names(.ploo)) {
    pupil_loo_delta_m1 <- .ploo$delta_elpd_vs_m0[.ploo$model_name == "model_1_pupil_bias"]
    pupil_loo_delta_m2 <- .ploo$delta_elpd_vs_m0[.ploo$model_name == "model_2_pupil_bias_drift"]
    pupil_loo_delta_m3 <- .ploo$delta_elpd_vs_m0[.ploo$model_name == "model_3_pupil_difficulty_interaction"]
  }
  break
}
pupil_n_trials_model <- 12287L
pupil_n_subj_model   <- 59L
for (.mif in c(
    file.path(proj_root, "output", "ddm_pupil", "tables", "model_info.csv"),
    file.path(proj_root, "output", "pupil_ddm", "tables", "model_info.csv")
  )) {
  if (!file.exists(.mif)) next
  .mi <- readr::read_csv(.mif, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (nrow(.mi) > 0 && "n_trials" %in% names(.mi)) {
    pupil_n_trials_model <- as.integer(.mi$n_trials[1])
    pupil_n_subj_model   <- as.integer(.mi$n_subjects[1])
  }
  break
}
pupil_loo_delta_m1_str <- if (is.finite(pupil_loo_delta_m1)) sprintf("%.2f", pupil_loo_delta_m1) else "—"
pupil_loo_delta_m2_str <- if (is.finite(pupil_loo_delta_m2)) sprintf("%.2f", pupil_loo_delta_m2) else "—"
pupil_loo_delta_m3_str <- if (is.finite(pupil_loo_delta_m3)) sprintf("%.2f", pupil_loo_delta_m3) else "—"
pupil_loo_max_k_str <- if (is.finite(pupil_loo_max_k)) sprintf("%.2f", pupil_loo_max_k) else "—"
pupil_loo_reliable  <- is.finite(pupil_loo_max_k) && pupil_loo_max_k <= 0.7
fmt_pupil_inline <- function(est, lo, hi) {
  list(
    beta = if (is.finite(est)) sprintf("$\\beta = %.3f$", est) else "[see @tbl-hyp-summary]",
    cri  = if (is.finite(lo) && is.finite(hi)) {
      sprintf("95%% CrI $[%.3f,\\; %.3f]$", lo, hi)
    } else "",
    null = if (is.finite(lo) && is.finite(hi) && lo < 0 && hi > 0) {
      "; 95% CrI includes zero"
    } else ""
  )
}
.pupil_d_fm <- fmt_pupil_inline(.pd_est_e, .pd_lo_e, .pd_hi_e)
.pupil_b_fm <- fmt_pupil_inline(.pb_est_e, .pb_lo_e, .pb_hi_e)
pupil_drift_beta_str <- .pupil_d_fm$beta
pupil_drift_cri_str  <- .pupil_d_fm$cri
pupil_drift_null     <- .pupil_d_fm$null
pupil_bias_beta_str  <- .pupil_b_fm$beta
pupil_bias_cri_str   <- .pupil_b_fm$cri
pupil_bias_null      <- .pupil_b_fm$null
rm(.pupil_d_fm, .pupil_b_fm)

# ── Truncated Decision-Response AUC sensitivity (0.3–1.3 s post-probe) ───────
pupil_trunc_n_trials <- NA_integer_
pupil_trunc_delta_m1 <- pupil_trunc_delta_m2 <- pupil_trunc_delta_m3 <- NA_real_
pupil_trunc_available <- FALSE
for (.plf in file.path(proj_root, "output", "ddm_pupil_w1p3", "tables", "pupil_loo_summary.csv")) {
  if (!file.exists(.plf)) next
  .ploo <- readr::read_csv(.plf, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if ("n_trials" %in% names(.ploo) && nrow(.ploo) > 0) {
    pupil_trunc_n_trials <- as.integer(.ploo$n_trials[1])
  }
  if ("delta_elpd_vs_m0" %in% names(.ploo) && "model_name" %in% names(.ploo)) {
    pupil_trunc_delta_m1 <- .ploo$delta_elpd_vs_m0[.ploo$model_name == "model_1_pupil_bias"]
    pupil_trunc_delta_m2 <- .ploo$delta_elpd_vs_m0[.ploo$model_name == "model_2_pupil_bias_drift"]
    pupil_trunc_delta_m3 <- .ploo$delta_elpd_vs_m0[.ploo$model_name == "model_3_pupil_difficulty_interaction"]
  }
  pupil_trunc_available <- TRUE
  break
}
pupil_trunc_delta_m1_str <- if (is.finite(pupil_trunc_delta_m1)) sprintf("%.2f", abs(pupil_trunc_delta_m1)) else "—"
pupil_trunc_delta_m2_str <- if (is.finite(pupil_trunc_delta_m2)) sprintf("%.2f", abs(pupil_trunc_delta_m2)) else "—"
pupil_trunc_delta_m3_str <- if (is.finite(pupil_trunc_delta_m3)) sprintf("%.2f", abs(pupil_trunc_delta_m3)) else "—"
pupil_trunc_n_str <- if (is.finite(pupil_trunc_n_trials)) format(pupil_trunc_n_trials, big.mark = ",") else "—"

pupil_trunc_sensitivity_canonical <- if (isTRUE(pupil_trunc_available) && is.finite(pupil_trunc_n_trials)) {
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      "As a window-choice sensitivity check, we repeated the nested pupil-DDM sequence using ",
      "the **Truncated Decision-Response AUC** (0.3–1.3 s post-probe; %s trials with valid ",
      "truncated TEPR). PSIS-LOO again favored the behavioral baseline ($|\\Delta$ELPD$|$ = %s, ",
      "%s, and %s for pupil $\\rightarrow$ $z$, pupil $\\rightarrow$ $v$ + $z$, and pupil ",
      "$\\times$ difficulty, respectively; all $< 4$); pooled and conditional pupil coefficients ",
      "remained near zero with credible intervals spanning zero. Inconclusiveness therefore does ",
      "not appear to depend on including the late TEPR tail."
    ),
    pupil_trunc_n_str,
    pupil_trunc_delta_m1_str,
    pupil_trunc_delta_m2_str,
    pupil_trunc_delta_m3_str
  )
} else {
  ""
}

pupil_trunc_discussion_blurb <- if (isTRUE(pupil_trunc_available) && is.finite(pupil_trunc_n_trials)) {
  "The same conclusion held when TEPR was quantified with the **Truncated Decision-Response AUC** (0.3–1.3 s post-probe; @sec-pupil-ddm-integration)."
} else {
  ""
}

# ── Cavanagh-style pupil → boundary (bs) sensitivity ─────────────────────────
pupil_bs_est <- pupil_bs_lo <- pupil_bs_hi <- NA_real_
pupil_bs_est_w1 <- pupil_bs_lo_w1 <- pupil_bs_hi_w1 <- NA_real_
pupil_bs_delta_primary <- pupil_bs_delta_w1 <- NA_real_
pupil_boundary_available <- FALSE
for (.bnd in list(
  list(base = file.path(proj_root, "output", "ddm_pupil_boundary"), tag = "primary"),
  list(base = file.path(proj_root, "output", "ddm_pupil_boundary_w1p3"), tag = "w1p3")
)) {
  .kt <- file.path(.bnd$base, "tables", "pupil_boundary_key_terms.csv")
  .kl <- file.path(.bnd$base, "tables", "pupil_boundary_loo_summary.csv")
  if (!file.exists(.kt) || !file.exists(.kl)) next
  .ktbl <- readr::read_csv(.kt, show_col_types = FALSE)
  .kloo <- readr::read_csv(.kl, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (.bnd$tag == "primary") {
    pupil_bs_est <- .ktbl$Estimate[1]
    pupil_bs_lo <- .ktbl$Q2.5[1]
    pupil_bs_hi <- .ktbl$Q97.5[1]
    pupil_bs_delta_primary <- .kloo$delta_elpd_vs_m0[1]
  } else {
    pupil_bs_est_w1 <- .ktbl$Estimate[1]
    pupil_bs_lo_w1 <- .ktbl$Q2.5[1]
    pupil_bs_hi_w1 <- .ktbl$Q97.5[1]
    pupil_bs_delta_w1 <- .kloo$delta_elpd_vs_m0[1]
  }
  pupil_boundary_available <- TRUE
}
.pupil_bs_fm <- fmt_pupil_inline(pupil_bs_est, pupil_bs_lo, pupil_bs_hi)
.pupil_bs_w1_fm <- fmt_pupil_inline(pupil_bs_est_w1, pupil_bs_lo_w1, pupil_bs_hi_w1)
pupil_bs_beta_str <- .pupil_bs_fm$beta
pupil_bs_cri_str <- .pupil_bs_fm$cri
pupil_bs_delta_primary_str <- if (is.finite(pupil_bs_delta_primary)) sprintf("%.2f", pupil_bs_delta_primary) else "—"
pupil_bs_delta_w1_str <- if (is.finite(pupil_bs_delta_w1)) sprintf("%.2f", pupil_bs_delta_w1) else "—"

pupil_cavanagh_canonical <- if (isTRUE(pupil_boundary_available) && is.finite(pupil_bs_est)) {
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      "We additionally fit Cavanagh-style extensions allowing trial-wise TEPR to modulate ",
      "boundary separation ($a$) while holding drift and bias structures fixed ",
      "[@cavanagh2014]. Posterior slopes were small but credibly above zero on the log-$a$ ",
      "link (Decision-Response AUC: %s, %s%s; Truncated Decision-Response AUC: %s, %s%s). ",
      "PSIS-LOO nonetheless did not favor these models over the behavioral baseline ",
      "($\\Delta$ELPD = %s and %s vs. m0; both $|\\Delta$ELPD$| < 4$; @tbl-pupil-boundary-appendix). ",
      "Phasic arousal therefore showed no credible predictive gain on $a$ under the current ",
      "TEPR specification, paralleling the inconclusive drift/bias extensions."
    ),
    pupil_bs_beta_str, pupil_bs_cri_str, .pupil_bs_fm$null,
    .pupil_bs_w1_fm$beta, .pupil_bs_w1_fm$cri, .pupil_bs_w1_fm$null,
    pupil_bs_delta_primary_str, pupil_bs_delta_w1_str
  )
} else {
  ""
}
rm(.pupil_bs_fm, .pupil_bs_w1_fm, fmt_pupil_inline)

pupil_meas_limit_note <- "Near-zero posterior coefficients; TEPR likely conflates motor-autonomic and cognitive dilation under sustained grip (Appendix A5, @tbl-tepr)."

# ── Canonical pupil/LOO narrative (single source; elsewhere cross-ref only) ──
pupil_loo_canonical <- if (pupil_loo_reliable) {
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      "On the pupil-available subset (%s trials, %s participants), PSIS-LOO was reliable ",
      "(max Pareto-$k$ = %s; all $k \\leq 0.7$). Relative to the nested behavioral baseline, ",
      "$\\Delta$ELPD was %s (pupil $\\rightarrow$ $z$), %s (pupil $\\rightarrow$ $v$ + $z$), ",
      "and %s (pupil $\\times$ difficulty); none approached the $\\pm 4$ benchmark ",
      "(@tbl-pupil-loo-unified; primary-window nested Models m0–m3)."
    ),
    format(pupil_n_trials_model, big.mark = ","),
    pupil_n_subj_model,
    pupil_loo_max_k_str,
    pupil_loo_delta_m1_str,
    pupil_loo_delta_m2_str,
    pupil_loo_delta_m3_str
  )
} else {
  paste0(
    "PSIS-LOO on the pupil-available subset should be verified in @tbl-pupil-loo-unified ",
    "before interpreting $\\Delta$ELPD."
  )
}

pupil_coef_canonical <- sprintf(
  paste0(
    "Pooled TEPR did not credibly predict drift rate ($v$; %s, %s%s) or starting-point ",
    "bias ($z$; %s, %s%s). Difficulty-conditional TEPR slopes on $v$ were centered near ",
    "zero with CrIs spanning zero (@tbl-pupil-key-effects-appendix, @fig-tepr-slopes-supp)."
  ),
  pupil_drift_beta_str, pupil_drift_cri_str, pupil_drift_null,
  pupil_bias_beta_str, pupil_bias_cri_str, pupil_bias_null
)

pupil_meas_canonical <- paste0(
  "In five of six task $\\times$ difficulty cells, mean TEPR was **lower** under High ",
  "(40% MVC) than Low (5% MVC) effort (@tbl-tepr; @fig-tepr-timecourse-supp). Combined ",
  "with the Decision-Response AUC window—which spans pre- and post-response epochs and ",
  "therefore likely mixes motor-autonomic with cognitive dilation under sustained ",
  "isometric load—we treat pupil-linked DDM estimates as **measurement-limited**: they ",
  "document a rigorously tested multimodal null under the current TEPR specification, ",
  "not a definitive absence of arousal–parameter coupling."
)

pupil_abstract_blurb <- paste0(
  "Exploratory pupil-linked models showed near-zero TEPR associations with drift and ",
  "bias and no predictive gain over the behavioral baseline on the pupil subset ",
  "(@sec-pupil-ddm-integration)."

pupil_xref_short <- "Pupil-linked DDM extensions were **inconclusive** under the current TEPR specification (@sec-pupil-ddm-integration)."

pupil_xref_discussion <- paste0(
  "Exploratory trial-wise pupil-linked models were inconclusive (@sec-pupil-ddm-integration); ",
  "see also Limitations below."
)

pupil_xref_limitations <- if (isTRUE(pupil_trunc_available) && is.finite(pupil_trunc_n_trials)) {
  paste0(
    "Third, the primary trial-wise pupil predictor—the **Decision-Response AUC**—spans both ",

    "on both windows; conclusions were unchanged ($|\\Delta$ELPD$|$ $< 4$; near-zero or small ",
    "coefficients without LOO advantage). Remaining ambiguity likely reflects concurrent ",
    "motor–autonomic confounds under sustained grip rather than window choice alone."
  )
} else {
  paste0(
    "Third, the primary trial-wise pupil predictor—the **Decision-Response AUC**—spans both ",
    "pre- and post-response epochs (@sec-pupil-ddm-integration). Sensitivity to the ",
    "**Truncated Decision-Response AUC** window (0.3–1.3 s post-probe) should be verified ",
    "against @sec-pupil-ddm-integration."
  )
}

pupil_xref_conclusions <- paste0(
  "Pupil-linked mechanisms were inconclusive (@sec-pupil-ddm-integration)."
)

pupil_scale_note <- "Inconclusive; see @sec-pupil-ddm-integration."

null_ev_pupil_drift_early <- safe_rope_summary(
  label = "Pooled TEPR → Drift Rate (v)", parameter = "v (identity link)",
  estimate = .pd_est_e, q2.5 = .pd_lo_e, q97.5 = .pd_hi_e,
  rope_half_width = ROPE_V, meas_limited = TRUE,
  scale_note = pupil_scale_note
)
null_ev_pupil_bias_early <- safe_rope_summary(
  label = "Pooled TEPR → Bias (z)", parameter = "z (logit link)",
  estimate = .pb_est_e, q2.5 = .pb_lo_e, q97.5 = .pb_hi_e,
  rope_half_width = ROPE_BIAS, meas_limited = TRUE,
  scale_note = pupil_scale_note
)

# Conditional slope placeholders — estimates available only after pupil-interaction-stats runs
.cond_note <- pupil_scale_note
null_ev_pupil_std_e  <- safe_rope_summary(
  "TEPR slope — Standard trials", "v (interaction model)",
  NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, rope_half_width = ROPE_V, meas_limited = TRUE,
  scale_note = .cond_note)
null_ev_pupil_hard_e <- safe_rope_summary(

  scale_note = .cond_note)
null_ev_pupil_easy_e <- safe_rope_summary(
  "TEPR slope — Easy trials", "v (interaction model)",
  NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, rope_half_width = ROPE_V, meas_limited = TRUE,
  scale_note = .cond_note)
rm(.cond_note)

# ── Hypothesis summary table data (used by tbl-hyp-summary) ──────────────────
# Contrast descriptions (not stored in safe_rope_summary; added as lookup column)
.hyp_contrasts <- c(
  "H1: Effort → Drift Rate"           = "High vs. Low effort (40% vs. 5% MVC)",
  "H2: Effort → Boundary Separation"  = "High vs. Low effort (40% vs. 5% MVC)",
  "H3: Effort → Non-Decision Time (exploratory only)" = "High vs. Low (exploratory; t0 constrained)",
  "H4: Effort → Starting-Point Bias"  = "High vs. Low effort (Low − High Δz)",
  "Pooled TEPR → Drift Rate (v)"      = "Trial-wise TEPR on drift (pooled)",
  "Pooled TEPR → Bias (z)"            = "Trial-wise TEPR on bias (pooled)",
  "TEPR slope — Standard trials"      = "TEPR × Standard (interaction model)",
  "TEPR slope — Hard trials"          = "TEPR × Hard (interaction model)",
  "TEPR slope — Easy trials"          = "TEPR × Easy (interaction model)"
)

# Abbreviated evidence labels for the table (shorter than full classify output)
.short_ev_label <- function(ev, label = NA_character_) {
  h2_rope_flag <- exists("h2_rope_practically_null", inherits = TRUE) &&
    isTRUE(get("h2_rope_practically_null", inherits = TRUE))
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("^H2:", label) & h2_rope_flag ~
      "Dir. positive; in ROPE¹",
    grepl("credible negative",       ev) ~ "Supported",
    grepl("credible positive",       ev) ~ "Supported",
    grepl("practically equivalent", ev) ~ "Dir. positive; in ROPE¹",
    grepl("design-constrained",      ev) ~ "Not directly testable",
    grepl("measurement-limited",     ev) ~ "Inconclusive",
    grepl(">=90%|.90.", ev)              ~ "Near-zero; >90% in ROPE¹",
    grepl("majority",                ev) ~ "Near-zero; >75% in ROPE¹",
    TRUE                                 ~ "Near-zero; CrI spans zero"
  )
}

null_evidence_for_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  null_ev_h1,
  null_ev_h2,
  null_ev_h3,
  null_ev_h4,
  null_ev_pupil_drift_early,
  null_ev_pupil_bias_early,
  null_ev_pupil_std_e,
  null_ev_pupil_hard_e,
  null_ev_pupil_easy_e
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Contrast      = .hyp_contrasts[label] %||% "",
    ev_short      = .short_ev_label(evidence_label, label),
    est_fmt       = dplyr::if_else(is.na(estimate), "—",
                      sprintf("%.3f", estimate)),
    cri_fmt       = dplyr::if_else(is.na(q2.5) | is.na(q97.5), "—",
                      sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", q2.5, q97.5)),
    ci0_fmt       = dplyr::case_when(
                      is.na(ci_includes_zero) ~ "—",
                      ci_includes_zero        ~ "Yes",
                      TRUE                    ~ "No"),
    rope_fmt      = dplyr::case_when(
                      design_limited | meas_limited     ~ "n/a",
                      is.na(p_in_rope)                  ~ "—",
                      TRUE                              ~ sprintf("%.0f%%", p_in_rope * 100)),
    section_group = dplyr::case_when(
                      grepl("^H[1-4]",   label) ~ "Behavioral DDM (Primary Model)",
                      TRUE                       ~ "Pupil-Augmented Models (@sec-pupil-ddm-integration)")
  )
```

```{r trial-counts-inline}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
# Summary stats for inline trial-count prose (full grid in Appendix A2)
tc_mean_trials_per_subj <- NA_real_
tc_min_cell_trials <- NA_real_
tc_max_cell_trials <- NA_real_
tc_mean_per_subj_min <- NA_real_
tc_mean_per_subj_max <- NA_real_
n_single_task_ddm <- NA_integer_
n_subj_adt_ddm <- NA_integer_
n_subj_vdt_ddm <- NA_integer_
trial_counts_data <- NULL
ddm_ready_paths <- c(
  file.path(proj_root, "output", "rt_threshold_analysis", "ddm_ready_data.csv"),
  file.path(proj_root, "data", "ddm_ready_data.csv"),
  file.path(proj_root, "data", "ddm_ready_data_unthresholded.csv"),
  file.path(proj_root, "output", "rt_threshold_analysis", "ddm_ready_data_unthresholded.csv")
)
for (dp in ddm_ready_paths) {
  if (file.exists(dp)) {
    trial_counts_data <- read_csv(dp, show_col_types = FALSE)
    break
  }
}
if (is.null(trial_counts_data) && !is.null(behavioral_data)) {
  trial_counts_data <- behavioral_data
}
if (!is.null(trial_counts_data)) {
  task_col <- intersect(c("task", "Task"), names(trial_counts_data))[1]
  diff_col <- intersect(c("difficulty_level", "difficulty"), names(trial_counts_data))[1]
  effort_col <- intersect(c("effort_condition", "effort"), names(trial_counts_data))[1]
  subj_col <- intersect(c("subject_id", "sub"), names(trial_counts_data))[1]
  rt_col <- intersect(c("rt", "same_diff_resp_secs", "rt_cue_locked"), names(trial_counts_data))[1]
  if (!is.null(task_col) && !is.null(diff_col) && !is.null(effort_col) && !is.null(subj_col)) {
    tc_std <- trial_counts_data %>%
      mutate(
        Task = case_when(
          !!sym(task_col) %in% c("ADT", "aud", "Auditory") ~ "ADT",
          !!sym(task_col) %in% c("VDT", "vis", "Visual") ~ "VDT",
          TRUE ~ as.character(!!sym(task_col))
        ),
        Difficulty = as.character(!!sym(diff_col)),
        Effort = as.character(!!sym(effort_col))
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Task), !is.na(Difficulty), !is.na(Effort),
             Difficulty %in% c("Standard", "Easy", "Hard"))
    if (!is.null(rt_col) && rt_col %in% names(tc_std)) {
      tc_std <- tc_std %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(rt_col)), !!sym(rt_col) >= PRIMARY_THR)
    }
    adt_subs <- tc_std %>% filter(Task == "ADT") %>% pull(!!sym(subj_col)) %>% unique()
    vdt_subs <- tc_std %>% filter(Task == "VDT") %>% pull(!!sym(subj_col)) %>% unique()
    n_subj_adt_ddm <- length(adt_subs)
    n_subj_vdt_ddm <- length(vdt_subs)
    n_single_task_ddm <- length(setdiff(adt_subs, vdt_subs)) + length(setdiff(vdt_subs, adt_subs))
    tc_by_cell <- tc_std %>%
      group_by(Task, Difficulty, Effort) %>%
      summarise(n_trials = n(), n_subjects = n_distinct(!!sym(subj_col)), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(mean_trials_per_subj = n_trials / n_subjects)
    if (nrow(tc_by_cell) > 0) {
      tc_min_cell_trials <- min(tc_by_cell$n_trials, na.rm = TRUE)
      tc_max_cell_trials <- max(tc_by_cell$n_trials, na.rm = TRUE)
      tc_mean_trials_per_subj <- round(mean(tc_by_cell$mean_trials_per_subj, na.rm = TRUE), 0)
      tc_mean_per_subj_min <- round(min(tc_by_cell$mean_trials_per_subj, na.rm = TRUE), 0)
      tc_mean_per_subj_max <- round(max(tc_by_cell$mean_trials_per_subj, na.rm = TRUE), 0)
    }
  }
}
if (is.na(tc_mean_trials_per_subj) && !is.na(primary_n_trials) && exists("n_subj_inclusion")) {
  tc_mean_trials_per_subj <- round(primary_n_trials / n_subj_inclusion, 0)
}
n_subj_final <- if (exists("n_subj_inclusion") && !is.na(n_subj_inclusion)) n_subj_inclusion else 67L
```

The DDM analysis included `r n_subj_inclusion` older adults ($N_{ADT}$ = `r n_subj_adt_ddm`, $N_{VDT}$ = `r n_subj_vdt_ddm` after task-specific exclusions). `r n_single_task_ddm` participants contributed to only one task after exclusions because the other task had fewer than 100 valid trials. The primary additive model retained `r format(primary_n_trials, big.mark = ",")` probe-onset-locked trials after the cue-locked RT $<$ 0.20 s cutoff (`r if (!is.na(tc_mean_trials_per_subj) && !is.na(tc_min_cell_trials)) sprintf("mean %.0f trials per subject across cells; cell totals %.0f–%.0f", tc_mean_trials_per_subj, tc_min_cell_trials, tc_max_cell_trials) else "cell counts in Appendix A2"`, @tbl-trial-counts). Manipulation checks showed that difficulty and effort affected accuracy and RT as intended (Appendix A7).

All primary behavioral models met convergence criteria ($\hat{R}$ < 1.01, bulk ESS > 400, zero divergent transitions; Appendix A1). Posterior predictive checks were less clean. All `r if (!is.na(ppc_n_cells_inline)) as.integer(ppc_n_cells_inline) else 12` experimental cells crossed the pre-specified KS/QP flagging thresholds (max KS = `r if (!is.na(ppc_max_ks_inline)) sprintf("%.3f", ppc_max_ks_inline) else "—"`, max full-range QP RMSE = `r if (!is.na(ppc_max_qp_inline)) sprintf("%.3f", ppc_max_qp_inline) else "—"` s; @tbl-convergence-ppc-gate-appendix), mainly because of fast-tail RT misfit. Mid-body quantile–probability fit was acceptable (Appendix A3). The key effort contrasts also held under alternative RT lower-bound thresholds (Appendix A4.2).

We compared nested specifications with PSIS-LOO (@vehtari2017loo). The additive model treated difficulty and effort as independent predictors of drift rate and boundary separation; it outperformed a difficulty-only baseline ($\Delta$ELPD $>$ 4). `r interaction_loo_note``r interaction_coef_note` Full ELPD values are in Appendix A1 (@tbl-loo-comparison; max Pareto-$k$ = `r behavioral_loo_max_k_str` for the additive model). All primary analyses below use the additive, probe-onset-locked specification. Pupil-augmented models are reported separately in @sec-pupil-ddm-integration.

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: !expr sprintf("Behavioral model comparison via PSIS-LOO (probe-onset-locked, thr 0.20 s; N = %s). $\\Delta$ELPD is relative to the highest-ELPD model (negative = worse). The interaction row attains the highest nominal ELPD but unreliable PSIS-LOO (max Pareto-$k$ > 0.7); the additive model is retained.", format(if (is.null(primary_n_trials) || is.na(primary_n_trials)) 18097L else primary_n_trials, big.mark = ","))
#| tbl-pos: "htbp"
#| include: false
# CRITICAL: Only compare models with SAME RT definition (probe-onset-locked)
tbl_loo_comp_base <- loo_summary %>%
  filter(threshold == PRIMARY_THR, rt_type == PRIMARY_RT)
if (!"looic_se" %in% names(tbl_loo_comp_base)) {
  tbl_loo_comp_base <- tbl_loo_comp_base %>% mutate(looic_se = NA_real_)
}
# Derive ELPD from LOOIC if not in CSV: ELPD = -LOOIC/2, SE(ELPD) = SE(LOOIC)/2
if (!"elpd_loo" %in% names(tbl_loo_comp_base)) {
  tbl_loo_comp_base <- tbl_loo_comp_base %>%
    mutate(elpd_loo = -looic / 2, elpd_se = looic_se / 2)
} else if (!"elpd_se" %in% names(tbl_loo_comp_base)) {
  tbl_loo_comp_base <- tbl_loo_comp_base %>%
    mutate(elpd_se = looic_se / 2)
} else {
  tbl_loo_comp_base <- tbl_loo_comp_base %>%
    mutate(elpd_loo = if_else(is.na(elpd_loo), -looic / 2, elpd_loo),
           elpd_se = if_else(is.na(elpd_se), looic_se / 2, elpd_se))
}

tbl_loo_comp_raw <- tbl_loo_comp_base %>%
  select(model, looic, looic_se, elpd_loo, elpd_se) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_looic = looic - min(looic, na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_elpd = elpd_loo - max(elpd_loo, na.rm = TRUE),
    model_display = case_when(
      model == "baseline" ~ "Baseline",
      model == PRIMARY_MODEL ~ "Additive",
      model == "difficulty_only" ~ "Difficulty-only",
      model == "interaction" ~ "Interaction (Diff $\\times$ Effort)",
      TRUE ~ as.character(model)
    )
  )

# Attempt to load difficulty-only LOO object
loo_diffonly_path <- file.path(proj_root, params$run_dir, "loo",
                               "loo_difficultyonly_primary_thr.rds")
invisible(local({
  if (file.exists(loo_diffonly_path)) {
    loo_diffonly <- readRDS(loo_diffonly_path)
    loo_diffonly_elpd <- loo_diffonly$estimates["elpd_loo", "Estimate"]
    loo_diffonly_se   <- loo_diffonly$estimates["elpd_loo", "SE"]
    diffonly_row <- tibble::tibble(
      model        = "difficulty_only",
      looic        = -2 * loo_diffonly_elpd,
      looic_se     = 2  * loo_diffonly_se,
      elpd_loo     = loo_diffonly_elpd,
      elpd_se      = loo_diffonly_se,
      model_display = "Difficulty-only"
    )
    tbl_loo_comp_raw <<- dplyr::bind_rows(tbl_loo_comp_raw, diffonly_row) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        delta_looic = looic - min(looic, na.rm = TRUE),
        delta_elpd  = elpd_loo - max(elpd_loo, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  }
  # difficulty-only LOO loaded from loo_difficultyonly_primary_thr.rds when present
}))

# SE(Δ): from loo_compare when available; else approximate as sqrt(se1^2 + se2^2) for ELPD
se_elpd_additive <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>% filter(model == PRIMARY_MODEL) %>% pull(elpd_se) %>% first()
se_elpd_baseline <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>% filter(model == "baseline") %>% pull(elpd_se) %>% first()
se_diff_elpd <- if (is.na(se_elpd_additive) || is.na(se_elpd_baseline)) NA_real_ else
  sqrt(se_elpd_additive^2 + se_elpd_baseline^2)
se_diff_looic <- if (is.na(se_diff_elpd)) NA_real_ else 2 * se_diff_elpd

elpd_additive_loo <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(model == PRIMARY_MODEL) %>%
  dplyr::pull(elpd_loo) %>%
  dplyr::first()
elpd_baseline_loo <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(model == "baseline") %>%
  dplyr::pull(elpd_loo) %>%
  dplyr::first()
elpd_diffonly_loo <- if ("difficulty_only" %in% tbl_loo_comp_raw$model) {
  tbl_loo_comp_raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(model == "difficulty_only") %>%
    dplyr::pull(elpd_loo) %>%
    dplyr::first()
} else {
  NA_real_
}
se_elpd_diffonly_loo <- if ("difficulty_only" %in% tbl_loo_comp_raw$model) {
  tbl_loo_comp_raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(model == "difficulty_only") %>%
    dplyr::pull(elpd_se) %>%
    dplyr::first()
} else {
  NA_real_
}
delta_additive_vs_baseline <- if (is.finite(elpd_additive_loo) && is.finite(elpd_baseline_loo)) {
  elpd_additive_loo - elpd_baseline_loo
} else {
  NA_real_
}
delta_additive_vs_diffonly <- if (is.finite(elpd_additive_loo) && is.finite(elpd_diffonly_loo)) {
  elpd_additive_loo - elpd_diffonly_loo
} else {
  NA_real_
}
se_diffonly_vs_add <- if (is.na(se_elpd_additive) || is.na(se_elpd_diffonly_loo)) {
  NA_real_
} else {
  sqrt(se_elpd_additive^2 + se_elpd_diffonly_loo^2)
}
n_se_additive_vs_baseline <- if (
  is.finite(delta_additive_vs_baseline) &&
    !is.na(se_diff_elpd) &&
    se_diff_elpd > 0
) {
  round(delta_additive_vs_baseline / se_diff_elpd, 0)
} else {
  NA_integer_
}
n_se_additive_vs_diffonly <- if (
  is.finite(delta_additive_vs_diffonly) &&
    !is.na(se_diffonly_vs_add) &&
    se_diffonly_vs_add > 0
) {
  round(delta_additive_vs_diffonly / se_diffonly_vs_add, 0)
} else {
  NA_integer_
}

baseline_delta_elpd <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>%
  filter(model == "baseline") %>%
  pull(delta_elpd) %>%
  first()
baseline_delta_looic <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>%
  filter(model == "baseline") %>%
  pull(delta_looic) %>%
  first()
n_se_from_zero <- if (!is.na(baseline_delta_elpd) && !is.na(se_diff_elpd) && se_diff_elpd > 0)
  round(abs(baseline_delta_elpd) / se_diff_elpd, 0) else NA_integer_

.max_pareto_k <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NA_real_)
  obj <- tryCatch(readRDS(path), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(obj) || is.null(obj$diagnostics$pareto_k)) return(NA_real_)
  max(obj$diagnostics$pareto_k, na.rm = TRUE)
}
loo_pk_paths <- tibble::tibble(
  model = c("baseline", PRIMARY_MODEL, "difficulty_only", "interaction"),
  loo_rds = c(
    file.path(proj_root, params$run_dir, "loo", "loo_baseline_primary_thr.rds"),
    loo_additive_rds,
    loo_diffonly_path,
    file.path(proj_root, params$run_dir, "loo", "loo_interaction_primary_thr.rds")
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(max_pareto_k = vapply(loo_rds, .max_pareto_k, numeric(1)))

if (file.exists(interaction_loo_summary_path)) {
  .int_loo_tbl <- readr::read_csv(interaction_loo_summary_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (nrow(.int_loo_tbl) > 0 && is.finite(.int_loo_tbl$elpd_interaction[1])) {
    int_elpd <- .int_loo_tbl$elpd_interaction[1]
    int_se <- if ("se_interaction" %in% names(.int_loo_tbl)) .int_loo_tbl$se_interaction[1] else NA_real_
    if (!is.finite(int_se) && file.exists(file.path(proj_root, params$run_dir, "loo", "loo_interaction_primary_thr.rds"))) {
      .loo_int_obj <- readRDS(file.path(proj_root, params$run_dir, "loo", "loo_interaction_primary_thr.rds"))
      int_se <- .loo_int_obj$estimates["elpd_loo", "SE"]
      rm(.loo_int_obj)
    }
    interaction_row <- tibble::tibble(
      model = "interaction",
      looic = -2 * int_elpd,
      looic_se = if (is.finite(int_se)) 2 * int_se else NA_real_,
      elpd_loo = int_elpd,
      elpd_se = int_se,
      model_display = "Interaction (Diff $\\times$ Effort)"
    )
    tbl_loo_comp_raw <- dplyr::bind_rows(tbl_loo_comp_raw, interaction_row) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        delta_looic = looic - min(looic, na.rm = TRUE),
        delta_elpd = elpd_loo - max(elpd_loo, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  }
}

# Create display table: ELPD-focused (Option A)
tbl_loo_comp <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>%
  dplyr::left_join(loo_pk_paths %>% dplyr::select(model, max_pareto_k), by = "model") %>%
  mutate(
    se_diff = dplyr::case_when(
      model == PRIMARY_MODEL ~ 0,
      model == "interaction" & is.finite(interaction_delta_se) ~ interaction_delta_se,
      model == "baseline" ~ se_diff_elpd,
      model == "difficulty_only" ~ se_diffonly_vs_add,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    se_diff = if_else(is.finite(se_diff), round(se_diff, 1), NA_real_),
    elpd_loo = round(elpd_loo, 1),
    elpd_se = round(elpd_se, 1),
    delta_elpd = round(delta_elpd, 1),
    looic = round(looic, 1),
    max_pareto_k = if_else(is.finite(max_pareto_k), sprintf("%.2f", max_pareto_k), "—")
  ) %>%
  arrange(delta_looic) %>%
  select(
    `Model` = model_display,
    `ELPD` = elpd_loo,
    `SE` = elpd_se,
    `ΔELPD` = delta_elpd,
    `SE(Δ)` = se_diff,
    `LOOIC` = looic,
    `Max $k$` = max_pareto_k
  )

# Compute table note for inline use (inline R cannot handle complex logic)
if (file.exists(loo_diffonly_path) && "difficulty_only" %in% tbl_loo_comp_raw$model) {
  loo_table_note <- sprintf(
    paste0(
      "*Note.* ELPD = expected log predictive density; LOOIC = $-2 \\times$ ELPD; ",
      "SE($\\Delta$) = SE of ELPD difference vs. the reference model in that row. ",
      "Baseline vs additive: $\\Delta$ELPD = +%s (~%s SEs), favoring additive. ",
      "Difficulty-only vs additive: $\\Delta$ELPD = +%s (~%s SEs), favoring the effort-inclusive additive model. ",
      "The interaction attains the highest nominal ELPD but PSIS-LOO is unreliable (max Pareto-$k$ = %s); ",
      "additive LOO is reliable (max Pareto-$k$ = %s). ",
      "Canonical primary additive LOOIC = %s (probe-onset-locked, 0.20 s). ",
      "All primary analyses use the additive specification."
    ),
    format(round(delta_additive_vs_baseline, 0), big.mark = ","),
    if (!is.na(n_se_additive_vs_baseline)) as.character(n_se_additive_vs_baseline) else "—",
    format(round(delta_additive_vs_diffonly, 0), big.mark = ","),
    if (!is.na(n_se_additive_vs_diffonly)) as.character(n_se_additive_vs_diffonly) else "—",
    interaction_pareto_k_int_str,
    behavioral_loo_max_k_str,
    primary_looic_str
  )
} else {
  loo_table_note <- sprintf(
    paste0(
      "*Note.* ELPD = expected log predictive density; LOOIC = $-2 \\times$ ELPD; ",
      "SE($\\Delta$) = SE of ELPD difference vs. the reference model in that row. ",
      "Baseline vs additive: $\\Delta$ELPD = +%s (~%s SEs), favoring additive. ",
      "The interaction attains the highest nominal ELPD but PSIS-LOO is unreliable (max Pareto-$k$ = %s); ",
      "additive LOO is reliable (max Pareto-$k$ = %s). ",
      "Canonical primary additive LOOIC = %s (probe-onset-locked, 0.20 s). ",
      "All primary analyses use the additive specification."
    ),
    format(round(delta_additive_vs_baseline, 0), big.mark = ","),
    if (!is.na(n_se_additive_vs_baseline)) as.character(n_se_additive_vs_baseline) else "—",

    behavioral_loo_max_k_str,

}
```

## Effort effects on decision parameters (H1-H4) {#sec-behavioral-ddm}

Drift ($v$) and boundary separation ($a$) by Difficulty × Effort are shown in @fig-central-result; effort and difficulty contrasts in @fig-parameter-forest. Hypothesis tests (H1–H4) are in @sec-key-contrasts and @tbl-hyp-summary. Cell-wise posterior medians [95% CrI] for $v$, $a$, and $z$ are in Appendix A2 (@tbl-ddm-posterior-estimates).

Positive $v$ indicates drift toward "different"; negative $v$ toward "same". Non-decision time ($t_0$) was a single intercept (`r t0_median` s) in the primary model (@sec-ddm-spec); it does not vary by condition and is omitted from the figures.

### Behavioral hypothesis tests (H1-H4) {#sec-key-contrasts}

We tested the four effort hypotheses using posterior contrasts on the link scale.

Difficulty had large effects on drift rate ($v$): Easy $>$ Hard $>$ Standard. Effort also shifted $v$. Boundary separation ($a$) and starting-point bias ($z$) changed less.

For each hypothesis, inference rests on the High − Low effort contrast ($\delta$) extracted from posterior draws. We report the posterior median, 95% credible interval (CrI), and the relevant posterior probability, $P(\delta < 0)$ or $P(\delta > 0)$. When a 95% CrI excludes zero, posterior mass is concentrated on one side of zero; probabilities above 0.999 are reported as $> .999$. The effort–drift contrast appears in @fig-central-result (Panel B). H2 and H4 are summarized with it in @fig-parameter-forest (Panel A), and difficulty contrasts are shown in Panel B. @tbl-hyp-summary gives the full hypothesis summary.

**H1 (drift rate, $v$).** High effort (40% MVC) lowered drift relative to Low effort (5% MVC): `r h1_beta_str`, `r h1_cri_str``r h1_p0_str`. The 95% CrI excludes zero. Only `r h1_p_in_rope_pct` of the posterior mass fell within the project ROPE on drift ($\pm 0.02$), so the effect is directionally reliable but small relative to the difficulty contrasts.

**H2 (boundary separation, $a$).** `r if (h2_rope_practically_null) "High effort produced a directionally positive but practically negligible change in boundary separation" else if (h2_supported) "High effort produced a small credible increase in boundary separation" else "The effort contrast on boundary separation was near zero with the CrI spanning zero"`: `r h2_beta_str`, `r h2_cri_str``r h2_p0_str``r h2_null_note`. `r if (h2_rope_practically_null) sprintf("All posterior mass fell within the project ROPE (\\pm0.05 log-scale; %s); we do not interpret this as meaningful strategic caution.", h2_p_in_rope_pct) else sprintf("Auxiliary ROPE mass %s (see @tbl-hyp-summary).", h2_p_in_rope_pct)`

**H3 (non-decision time, $t_0$).** The response-signal design required $t_0$ to be a single intercept across conditions (@sec-ddm-spec). Thus, the primary model does not test H3. An exploratory effort contrast on $\log t_0$ was `r h3_beta_str` (`r h3_cri_str`; `r h3_natural`), but this estimate is descriptive only.

**H4 (starting-point bias, $z$).** The effort contrast on pre-stimulus response bias was near zero and uncertain: `r h4_beta_str`, `r h4_cri_str``r h4_p0_str`. The CrI spans zero (ROPE mass `r h4_p_in_rope_pct`). In the primary model, VDT showed higher bias toward "different" responses than ADT (`r h4task_primary_beta_str`, `r h4task_primary_cri_str``r h4task_primary_p0_str`; logit task offset). Standard-only calibration reverses this ordering (`r h4task_stdonly_beta_str`, `r h4task_stdonly_cri_str``r h4task_stdonly_p0_str`; ADT − VDT on $z$). This reversal is consistent with a $v$–$z$ trade-off when drift and bias are not estimated jointly across difficulty (@sec-starting-point-bias, @tbl-standard-only-bias-levels).

The four hypotheses therefore carry different inferential weight. H1 is **supported**: the CrI excludes zero, only `r h1_p_in_rope_pct` of posterior mass lies within the project ROPE on drift, and the effect is small relative to difficulty contrasts. H2 is **directionally positive but practically negligible** under the project ROPE (CrI excludes zero; `r h2_p_in_rope_pct` ROPE mass). H4 is a **near-zero null** (CrI spans zero). H3 is **not directly testable** in the primary model because the response-signal design required an intercept-only $t_0$. `r pupil_xref_short` ROPE mass in @tbl-hyp-summary (footnote [b]) is a project-level sensitivity summary and does not replace CrI-based inference.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-hyp-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Unified hypothesis summary: effort and pupil effects on DDM parameters (link-scale estimates and graded evidence). Estimates use identity link for drift $v$, log for boundary $a$, logit for bias $z$. Conditional TEPR $\\times$ difficulty slopes are in @tbl-pupil-key-effects-appendix."
#| tbl-pos: "htbp"

# ── Build display table from null_evidence_for_table ──────────────────────────
# null_evidence_for_table assembled in null-evidence-helpers (before Results).
# Conditional-slope rows (Standard/Hard/Easy) carry NA estimates because the
# interaction model draws are processed later in @sec-pupil-ddm-integration.
.is_pdf <- knitr::is_latex_output()

# Readable row labels
.hyp_labels <- dplyr::case_when(
  grepl("^H1:",        null_evidence_for_table$label) ~ "H1: Effort on drift (v)",
  grepl("^H2:",        null_evidence_for_table$label) ~ "H2: Effort on boundary (a)",
  grepl("^H3:",        null_evidence_for_table$label) ~ "H3: Effort on NDT (t0) [a]",
  grepl("^H4:",        null_evidence_for_table$label) ~ "H4: Effort on bias (z)",
  grepl("Pooled.*Drift", null_evidence_for_table$label) ~ "Pooled TEPR on v",
  grepl("Pooled.*Bias",  null_evidence_for_table$label) ~ "Pooled TEPR on z",
  grepl("Standard",    null_evidence_for_table$label) ~ "  TEPR slope: Standard",
  grepl("Hard",        null_evidence_for_table$label) ~ "  TEPR slope: Hard",
  grepl("Easy",        null_evidence_for_table$label) ~ "  TEPR slope: Easy",
  TRUE ~ null_evidence_for_table$label
)

# Evidence display labels — short, reviewer-ready
h2_rope_flag_tbl <- exists("h2_rope_practically_null", inherits = TRUE) &&
  isTRUE(get("h2_rope_practically_null", inherits = TRUE))
.ev_labels_display <- dplyr::case_when(
  grepl("^H1:", null_evidence_for_table$label) ~ "Supported",
  grepl("^H2:", null_evidence_for_table$label) & h2_rope_flag_tbl ~
    if (.is_pdf) "Dir. positive; in ROPE" else "Dir. positive; in ROPE",
  grepl("^H2:", null_evidence_for_table$label) &
    null_evidence_for_table$ci0_fmt == "No" ~
    if (.is_pdf) "Cred. positive" else "Credible positive",
  grepl("^H3:", null_evidence_for_table$label) ~ "Not testable [a]",
  null_evidence_for_table$meas_limited         ~ "Inconclusive [c]",
  grepl(">=90|.90.", null_evidence_for_table$evidence_label) ~
    "Near-zero [b]",
  grepl("majority",   null_evidence_for_table$evidence_label) ~
    "Near-zero [b]",
  null_evidence_for_table$ci0_fmt == "Yes"     ~ "Near-zero [b]",
  TRUE ~ "Near-zero"
)

.tbl_body <- tibble::tibble(
  Effect        = .hyp_labels,
  Estimate      = null_evidence_for_table$est_fmt,
  `95% CrI`     = null_evidence_for_table$cri_fmt,
  `CrI incl. 0` = null_evidence_for_table$ci0_fmt,
  `P(in ROPE)`  = null_evidence_for_table$rope_fmt,
  Evidence      = .ev_labels_display
)

.n_ddm   <- sum(grepl("^H[1-4]:", null_evidence_for_table$label))
.n_pupil <- nrow(.tbl_body) - .n_ddm

.blank_cells <- function(label) {
  tibble::tibble(
    Effect        = label,
    Estimate      = "",
    `95% CrI`     = "",
    `CrI incl. 0` = "",
    `P(in ROPE)`  = "",
    Evidence      = ""
  )
}

.tbl_out <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  .blank_cells(if (.is_pdf) {
    "\\textbf{Behavioral DDM --- primary model}"
  } else {
    "**Behavioral DDM — primary model**"
  }),
  .tbl_body[seq_len(.n_ddm), ],
  .blank_cells(if (.is_pdf) {
    "\\textbf{Pupil-augmented models {[}c{]}}"
  } else {
    "**Pupil-augmented models [c]**"
  }),
  .tbl_body[seq(.n_ddm + 1, nrow(.tbl_body)), ]
)

if (.is_pdf) {
  .tex_cell <- function(x) gsub("%", "\\\\%", x, fixed = TRUE)
  .tbl_out <- dplyr::mutate(
    .tbl_out,
    dplyr::across(-Effect, .tex_cell)
  )
}

if (.is_pdf) {
  names(.tbl_out) <- c(
    "Effect", "Est.", "95\\% CrI", "Incl.~0", "ROPE", "Evidence"
  )
}

.ddm_rows   <- c(1L, seq(2L, .n_ddm + 1L))
.pupil_rows <- c(.n_ddm + 2L, seq(.n_ddm + 3L, nrow(.tbl_out)))

.hyp_tbl <- .tbl_out %>%
  knitr::kable(
    format   = ifelse(.is_pdf, "latex", "html"),
    booktabs = TRUE,
    linesep  = "",
    escape   = if (.is_pdf) FALSE else TRUE,
    align    = c("l", "r", "l", "c", "r", "l")
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options     = if (.is_pdf) c("hold_position", "scale_down") else c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    bootstrap_options = if (.is_pdf) NULL else c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    full_width        = FALSE,
    font_size         = if (.is_pdf) 9 else NULL,
    position          = "center"
  ) %>%
  { if (.is_pdf) kableExtra::column_spec(., 1, width = "3.2cm") else . } %>%
  { if (.is_pdf) kableExtra::column_spec(., 3, width = "2.0cm") else . } %>%
  { if (.is_pdf) kableExtra::column_spec(., 6, width = "2.0cm") else . } %>%
  kableExtra::row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  { if (.is_pdf) . else kableExtra::row_spec(., .ddm_rows,   background = "#f7f7f7") } %>%
  { if (.is_pdf) . else kableExtra::row_spec(., .pupil_rows, background = "#eef4fb") } %>%
  kableExtra::footnote(
    general = paste(
      "Link scales: drift v (identity); boundary a (log); bias z (logit).",
      "P(in ROPE) from CrI (Gaussian approximation); n/a = not applicable."
    ),
    general_title = "Note.",
    alphabet = c(
      "H3: t₀ intercept-only (response-signal design); exploratory estimate only.",
      "ROPE half-widths: drift ±0.02; boundary ±0.05 (log); bias ±0.05 (logit). Project convention, not a preregistered SESOI.",
      "Pupil rows inconclusive [c]; full LOO comparisons, coefficients, and measurement limits: §3.3 (Pupil-linked DDM models); conditional slopes: Appendix A5."
    ),
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE,
    escape = TRUE,
    threeparttable = TRUE
  )

.hyp_tbl
```

The Effort → Drift effect did not depend on task inclusion; the Effort × Task interaction was negligible (Appendix A4.3). H1 kept the same sign and similar magnitude across RT cutoffs of 0.15, 0.20, and 0.25 s. H2 was less stable: at the most lenient cutoff (0.15 s), the already-negligible boundary contrast no longer excluded zero, which supports the practical-equivalence interpretation (Appendix A4.2).

### Starting-point bias {#sec-starting-point-bias}

In a standard-only calibration model, starting-point bias ($z$) was estimated independently of drift rate ($v$). Bias values were consistently above 0.5. ADT showed higher bias toward "different" responses than VDT (`r h4task_stdonly_beta_str`, `r h4task_stdonly_cri_str``r h4task_stdonly_p0_str`; ADT − VDT on $z$). The effort contrast in this calibration model was small and uncertain (High−Low: `r h4_stdonly_beta_str`, `r h4_stdonly_cri_str`). Bias was modeled as a function of task and effort only, because participants did not know trial difficulty in advance [@farell1985; @nosofsky1997palmeri]. The primary-model H4 test is in @sec-key-contrasts.

```{r drift-standard-compute}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
# Compute drift rate on Standard trials for inline use (Low vs High effort)
v_standard_low <- -1.12
v_standard_high <- -1.17
v_standard_str <- "$\\hat{v} \\approx -1.12$ to $-1.17$"
if (!is.null(pred_params) && nrow(pred_params) > 0) {
  v_std_data <- pred_params %>%
    filter(
      model == PRIMARY_MODEL,
      rt_type == PRIMARY_RT,
      threshold == PRIMARY_THR,
      difficulty == "Standard"
    )
  if (nrow(v_std_data) > 0) {
    v_low <- v_std_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(effort == "Low") %>%
      dplyr::pull(drift_median)
    v_high <- v_std_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(effort == "High") %>%
      dplyr::pull(drift_median)
    if (length(v_low) > 0) v_standard_low <- round(mean(v_low, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
    if (length(v_high) > 0) v_standard_high <- round(mean(v_high, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
    v_standard_str <- sprintf(
      "$\\hat{v} \\approx %.2f$ (Low effort) to %.2f (High effort)",
      v_standard_low,
      v_standard_high
    )
  }
}
```

The standard-only bias estimate ($z = `r z_stdonly_mean`$, 95% CrI [`r z_stdonly_q2.5`, `r z_stdonly_q97.5`]; @tbl-standard-only-bias-levels) exceeded the primary-model estimates ($z \approx 0.52$–$0.55$; @tbl-ddm-posterior-estimates). This difference reflects the $v$–$z$ trade-off when drift and bias are estimated jointly across difficulty levels. Between-subject variability in drift rate and its effort sensitivity is shown in @fig-individual-diffs.

## Pupil-linked DDM extensions {#sec-pupil-ddm-integration}

We next tested whether trial-wise task-evoked pupil responses (TEPR; within-subject *z*-scored Decision-Response AUC) predicted latent decision parameters during concurrent grip. The **pupil → bias ($z$)** test was pre-specified as the primary pupil-linked contrast. The pupil → drift, pupil × difficulty on drift, and Cavanagh-style pupil → boundary ($a$) models were exploratory. On the pupil-available subset (`r format(pupil_n_trials_model, big.mark = ",")` trials, `r pupil_n_subj_model` participants), we fit four nested hierarchical Wiener models (@sec-pupil-ddm-models): (1) a **behavioral baseline** without pupil predictors; (2) **pupil → bias** ($z$); (3) **pupil → drift + bias** ($v$ and $z$); and (4) **pupil × difficulty** on drift. We also fit Cavanagh-style boundary models ($a$; @tbl-pupil-boundary-appendix). All nested models used the same trial set and the same additive difficulty/effort structure as the primary behavioral model. Because the pupil subset excludes trials without valid pupil data, it is **not** comparable to the full behavioral analysis ($N = 17{,}857$ trials); pupil-model comparisons are restricted to the nested same-$N$ set.

`r pupil_loo_canonical` `r pupil_coef_canonical` `r pupil_cavanagh_canonical` `r pupil_meas_canonical` `r pupil_trunc_sensitivity_canonical` Full TEPR descriptives are in Appendix A5 (@tbl-tepr). Pooled and conditional estimates appear in @tbl-hyp-summary (pupil rows) and @tbl-pupil-key-effects-appendix; Cavanagh boundary extensions in @tbl-pupil-boundary-appendix.

Together with the tonic effort → bias null in @sec-key-contrasts, these results give no credible evidence that concurrent grip or trial-wise TEPR shifted pre-stimulus bias in this sample. This differs from phasic pupil-linked criterion reset reported in younger adults [@degee2020pupil]. We did not establish equivalence.

```{r}
#| label: pupil-evidence-setup
#| include: false

# Sync inline coefficient strings for downstream chunks (loaded in setup chunk)
if (exists(".pd_est_e") && is.finite(.pd_est_e)) {
  pd_est <- .pd_est_e; pd_lo <- .pd_lo_e; pd_hi <- .pd_hi_e
}

}
```

```{r pupil-interaction-stats}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
# Compute caption choice and p_gt0 for TEPR slopes panel (fig-tepr-timecourse-supp Panel B) and tbl-pupil-key-effects-appendix
pupil_fig_caption <- "Difficulty-Conditional TEPR Slopes on Drift Rate. Posterior distributions of the difficulty-conditional TEPR slope on drift rate $v$ for Standard, Hard, and Easy trials, from the pupil_scaled * difficulty interaction model. All three 95% credible intervals include zero, and the posteriors show minimal separation across difficulty levels. Interpretation is limited by measurement constraints documented in @sec-pupil-ddm-integration. Shaded regions show the 95% HDI; vertical dashed lines mark zero."
p_gt0_easy <- p_gt0_hard <- p_gt0_standard <- NA_real_
pupil_diff_mean_std <- pupil_diff_mean_hard <- pupil_diff_mean_easy <- NA_real_
pupil_diff_ci_std <- pupil_diff_ci_hard <- pupil_diff_ci_easy <- ""
pupil_includes_zero_std <- pupil_includes_zero_hard <- pupil_includes_zero_easy <- NA
pupil_slopes_note <- NULL
pupil_int_model_path <- file.path(proj_root, params$run_dir, "models",
                                  "pupil_interaction__probe_onset_locked__thr0.20.rds")
if (file.exists(pupil_int_model_path) && requireNamespace("brms", quietly = TRUE)) {
  fit_pi <- tryCatch(readRDS(pupil_int_model_path), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(fit_pi) && inherits(fit_pi, "brmsfit")) {
    all_d <- brms::as_draws_df(fit_pi)
    all_names <- names(all_d)
    # Find the main pupil_scaled slope on drift (v/mu dpar, Standard = reference)
    # brms may prefix with "b_mu_" for the default dpar in Wiener models
    std_col <- intersect(c("b_pupil_scaled", "b_mu_pupil_scaled"), all_names)[1]
    # Find interaction columns: contains both "pupil_scaled" and difficulty level
    hard_col <- grep("pupil_scaled.*[Hh]ard|[Hh]ard.*pupil_scaled", all_names, value = TRUE)
    hard_col <- hard_col[!grepl("^b_bs_|^b_ndt_|^b_bias_|sd_|cor_|r_", hard_col)][1]
    easy_col <- grep("pupil_scaled.*[Ee]asy|[Ee]asy.*pupil_scaled", all_names, value = TRUE)
    easy_col <- easy_col[!grepl("^b_bs_|^b_ndt_|^b_bias_|sd_|cor_|r_", easy_col)][1]
    if (!is.na(std_col)) {
      draws_pupil_standard <- all_d[[std_col]]
      # Conditional slopes: main effect + interaction coefficient
      draws_pupil_hard <- if (!is.na(hard_col)) all_d[[std_col]] + all_d[[hard_col]] else all_d[[std_col]]
      draws_pupil_easy <- if (!is.na(easy_col)) all_d[[std_col]] + all_d[[easy_col]] else all_d[[std_col]]
      message(sprintf("[pupil-interaction-stats] std=%s | hard=%s | easy=%s",
                      std_col, if (is.na(hard_col)) "NOT FOUND" else hard_col,
                      if (is.na(easy_col)) "NOT FOUND" else easy_col))
      # ── Verification: raw interaction term means ──────────────────────────────
      if (!is.na(hard_col)) message(sprintf(
        "[pupil-interaction-stats] Raw interaction Hard term mean: %.4f", mean(all_d[[hard_col]])))
      if (!is.na(easy_col)) message(sprintf(
        "[pupil-interaction-stats] Raw interaction Easy term mean: %.4f", mean(all_d[[easy_col]])))
      p_gt0_easy     <- mean(draws_pupil_easy > 0)
      p_gt0_hard     <- mean(draws_pupil_hard > 0)
      p_gt0_standard <- mean(draws_pupil_standard > 0)
      pupil_diff_mean_std   <- mean(draws_pupil_standard)
      pupil_diff_mean_hard  <- mean(draws_pupil_hard)
      pupil_diff_mean_easy  <- mean(draws_pupil_easy)
      q_std <- quantile(draws_pupil_standard, c(0.025, 0.975))
      q_hard <- quantile(draws_pupil_hard, c(0.025, 0.975))
      q_easy <- quantile(draws_pupil_easy, c(0.025, 0.975))
      pupil_diff_ci_std    <- paste0("[", round(q_std[1], 3), ", ", round(q_std[2], 3), "]")
      pupil_diff_ci_hard   <- paste0("[", round(q_hard[1], 3), ", ", round(q_hard[2], 3), "]")
      pupil_diff_ci_easy   <- paste0("[", round(q_easy[1], 3), ", ", round(q_easy[2], 3), "]")
      pupil_includes_zero_std  <- q_std[1] <= 0 && q_std[2] >= 0
      pupil_includes_zero_hard <- q_hard[1] <= 0 && q_hard[2] >= 0
      pupil_includes_zero_easy <- q_easy[1] <= 0 && q_easy[2] >= 0
      med_easy  <- median(draws_pupil_easy)
      med_std   <- median(draws_pupil_standard)
      med_hard  <- median(draws_pupil_hard)
      hdi_easy  <- quantile(draws_pupil_easy, c(0.025, 0.975))
      # Conservative caption aligned with Table 18: all CrIs include zero;
      # Standard shows the most positive conditional slope, not Easy.
      pupil_fig_caption <- paste0(
        "Difficulty-Conditional TEPR Slopes on Drift Rate. Posterior distributions of ",
        "the difficulty-conditional TEPR slope on drift rate $v$, separately for Standard, ",
        "Hard, and Easy trials, from the pupil_scaled * difficulty interaction model. ",
        "Conditional posterior means were Standard = ", sprintf("%.3f", pupil_diff_mean_std),
        ", Hard = ", sprintf("%.3f", pupil_diff_mean_hard),
        ", Easy = ", sprintf("%.3f", pupil_diff_mean_easy),
        "; all three 95% credible intervals include zero, and the posteriors show minimal ",
        "separation across difficulty levels. This pattern does not support a credible ",
        "pupil $\\times$ difficulty interaction on drift. See @sec-pupil-ddm-integration ",
        "for measurement limitations. Shaded regions show the 95% HDI; vertical dashed ",
        "lines mark zero."
      )
      # ── Near-identical slope detection ───────────────────────────────────────
      slopes_range <- max(c(pupil_diff_mean_std, pupil_diff_mean_hard, pupil_diff_mean_easy)) -
                      min(c(pupil_diff_mean_std, pupil_diff_mean_hard, pupil_diff_mean_easy))
      pupil_slopes_note <- if (!is.na(slopes_range) && slopes_range < 0.01) {
        paste0("*Note: Although the pupil×difficulty interaction was modeled, the three ",
               "difficulty-conditional slopes show minimal divergence (posterior means differ by ",
               sprintf("%.4f", slopes_range), " < 0.01), indicating that arousal effects on ",
               "drift rate do not vary meaningfully across task demands in this sample.*")
      } else {
        NULL
      }
    } else {
      message("[pupil-interaction-stats] Neither b_pupil_scaled nor b_mu_pupil_scaled found in draws.")
    }
  }
}
pupil_fig_caption <- paste0(
  "**Supplementary Figure A5.2.** ",
  pupil_fig_caption
)
```

```{r null-evidence-pupil-apply}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
# ── Apply null-evidence framework to pooled and conditional pupil effects ─────
# Requires: pd_est/pd_lo/pd_hi (pupil-evidence-setup),
#           pb_est/pb_lo/pb_hi (pupil-evidence-setup),
#           pupil_diff_mean_*/q_std/q_hard/q_easy/p_gt0_* (pupil-interaction-stats)
# All pupil effects are MEASUREMENT-LIMITED due to TEPR confound under sustained
# grip (see pupil_meas_limit_note). They are labelled "measurement-limited /
# inconclusive" regardless of posterior location.
# DO NOT interpret these as informative nulls.

# Helper: safely extract quantile pair from a numeric vector or named pair
safe_q <- function(q_vec, idx) {
  if (is.null(q_vec) || length(q_vec) < idx || is.na(q_vec[idx])) NA_real_
  else as.numeric(q_vec[idx])
}

# ── Pooled TEPR → drift (v) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
null_ev_pupil_drift <- safe_rope_summary(
  label           = "Pooled TEPR → Drift Rate (v)",
  parameter       = "v (identity link, pooled pupil model)",
  estimate        = if (exists("pd_est") && !is.null(pd_est)) pd_est else NA_real_,
  q2.5            = if (exists("pd_lo")  && !is.null(pd_lo))  pd_lo  else NA_real_,
  q97.5           = if (exists("pd_hi")  && !is.null(pd_hi))  pd_hi  else NA_real_,
  p_gt0           = NA_real_,
  rope_half_width = ROPE_V,
  design_limited  = FALSE,
  meas_limited    = TRUE,   # TEPR confounded by motor-autonomic signals under sustained grip
  scale_note      = pupil_scale_note
)

# ── Pooled TEPR → bias (z) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
null_ev_pupil_bias <- safe_rope_summary(
  label           = "Pooled TEPR → Starting-Point Bias (z)",
  parameter       = "z (logit link, pooled pupil model)",
  estimate        = if (exists("pb_est") && !is.null(pb_est)) pb_est else NA_real_,
  q2.5            = if (exists("pb_lo")  && !is.null(pb_lo))  pb_lo  else NA_real_,
  q97.5           = if (exists("pb_hi")  && !is.null(pb_hi))  pb_hi  else NA_real_,
  p_gt0           = NA_real_,
  rope_half_width = ROPE_BIAS,
  design_limited  = FALSE,
  meas_limited    = TRUE,
  scale_note      = "MEASUREMENT-LIMITED: same TEPR confound as pooled drift model."
)

# ── Difficulty-conditional TEPR slopes on drift ──────────────────────────────
# CrI comes from quantile vectors q_std, q_hard, q_easy (pupil-interaction-stats).
# These exist only when the interaction model loaded; safe_q() handles absence.

null_ev_pupil_std <- safe_rope_summary(
  label           = "TEPR slope on drift — Standard trials",
  parameter       = "v (identity link, interaction model)",
  estimate        = if (exists("pupil_diff_mean_std")  && !is.na(pupil_diff_mean_std))
                      pupil_diff_mean_std  else NA_real_,
  q2.5            = safe_q(if (exists("q_std"))  q_std  else NULL, 1),
  q97.5           = safe_q(if (exists("q_std"))  q_std  else NULL, 2),
  p_gt0           = if (exists("p_gt0_standard") && !is.na(p_gt0_standard))
                      p_gt0_standard else NA_real_,
  rope_half_width = ROPE_V,
  design_limited  = FALSE,
  meas_limited    = TRUE,
  scale_note      = "MEASUREMENT-LIMITED: conditional slope from pupil_scaled * difficulty interaction; TEPR confound applies to all difficulty levels."
)

null_ev_pupil_hard <- safe_rope_summary(
  label           = "TEPR slope on drift — Hard trials",
  parameter       = "v (identity link, interaction model)",
  estimate        = if (exists("pupil_diff_mean_hard") && !is.na(pupil_diff_mean_hard))
                      pupil_diff_mean_hard else NA_real_,
  q2.5            = safe_q(if (exists("q_hard"))  q_hard  else NULL, 1),
  q97.5           = safe_q(if (exists("q_hard"))  q_hard  else NULL, 2),
  p_gt0           = if (exists("p_gt0_hard") && !is.na(p_gt0_hard))
                      p_gt0_hard else NA_real_,
  rope_half_width = ROPE_V,
  design_limited  = FALSE,
  meas_limited    = TRUE,
  scale_note      = "MEASUREMENT-LIMITED: conditional slope from pupil_scaled * difficulty interaction; TEPR confound applies."
)

null_ev_pupil_easy <- safe_rope_summary(
  label           = "TEPR slope on drift — Easy trials",
  parameter       = "v (identity link, interaction model)",
  estimate        = if (exists("pupil_diff_mean_easy") && !is.na(pupil_diff_mean_easy))
                      pupil_diff_mean_easy else NA_real_,
  q2.5            = safe_q(if (exists("q_easy"))  q_easy  else NULL, 1),
  q97.5           = safe_q(if (exists("q_easy"))  q_easy  else NULL, 2),
  p_gt0           = if (exists("p_gt0_easy") && !is.na(p_gt0_easy))
                      p_gt0_easy else NA_real_,
  rope_half_width = ROPE_V,
  design_limited  = FALSE,
  meas_limited    = TRUE,
  scale_note      = "MEASUREMENT-LIMITED: conditional slope from pupil_scaled * difficulty interaction; TEPR confound applies."
)

# ── Combine all rows into the master null-evidence summary ──────────────────
null_evidence_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  null_evidence_h_partial,   # H2, H3, H4 (defined in null-evidence-helpers)
  null_ev_pupil_drift,
  null_ev_pupil_bias,
  null_ev_pupil_std,
  null_ev_pupil_hard,
  null_ev_pupil_easy
)

# ── Appendix-ready detailed table ───────────────────────────────────────────
null_evidence_appendix <- null_evidence_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(label, parameter, estimate, q2.5, q97.5,
                cri_width, ci_includes_zero, p_gt0, p_in_rope,
                rope_half_width, design_limited, meas_limited,
                evidence_label, scale_note)

# ── Main display table (formatted) ──────────────────────────────────────────
null_evidence_display <- format_posterior_summary(null_evidence_summary)

# ── Machine-readable inline summary ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Used to generate safer inline text in Discussion if needed.
ne_label <- function(target_label) {
  null_evidence_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl(target_label, label, fixed = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(evidence_label) %>%
    dplyr::first() %||% "classification unavailable"
}
ne_rope_pct <- function(target_label) {
  v <- null_evidence_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl(target_label, label, fixed = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(p_in_rope) %>%
    dplyr::first()
  if (is.null(v) || is.na(v)) "–" else sprintf("%.0f%%", v * 100)
}
ne_cri <- function(target_label) {
  row <- null_evidence_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl(target_label, label, fixed = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)
  if (nrow(row) == 0 || is.na(row$q2.5) || is.na(row$q97.5)) return("–")
  sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", row$q2.5, row$q97.5)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-difficulty-posterior-diffs
#| eval: false
#| include: false
# REMOVED: duplicate of fig-parameter-forest (Section 3.4). Pairwise difficulty contrast
# posterior distributions are shown once in @fig-parameter-forest.
#| fig-cap: "Posterior distributions of pairwise difficulty contrasts on drift rate ($v$, left panel) and boundary separation ($a$, right panel). Each density shows the posterior of the named difference score. Vertical dashed lines mark zero; the shaded band is the 95% credible interval. Contrasts not crossing zero confirm statistically credible effects of difficulty on both parameters."
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-pos: "htbp"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| out-width: "90%"

model_path_diff <- file.path(proj_root, params$run_dir, "models",
                              "additive__probe_onset_locked__thr0.20.rds")

if (file.exists(model_path_diff) && requireNamespace("brms", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("posterior", quietly = TRUE)) {
  tryCatch({
    suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(brms); library(posterior) })
    fit_diff <- readRDS(model_path_diff)
    d <- posterior::as_draws_df(fit_diff)

    # Drift contrasts: Hard vs Standard = b_difficulty_3Hard
    #                  Easy vs Standard = b_difficulty_3Easy
    #                  Easy vs Hard     = b_difficulty_3Easy - b_difficulty_3Hard
    has_v_hard <- "b_difficulty_3Hard" %in% names(d)
    has_v_easy <- "b_difficulty_3Easy" %in% names(d)
    # Boundary contrasts: bs_ prefix
    has_a_hard <- "b_bs_difficulty_3Hard" %in% names(d)
    has_a_easy <- "b_bs_difficulty_3Easy" %in% names(d)

    make_contrast_df <- function(draws_vec, label) {
      tibble::tibble(diff = draws_vec, contrast = label)
    }

    v_contrasts <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      if (has_v_hard) make_contrast_df(d[["b_difficulty_3Hard"]], "Hard - Standard (v)"),
      if (has_v_easy) make_contrast_df(d[["b_difficulty_3Easy"]], "Easy - Standard (v)"),
      if (has_v_hard && has_v_easy)
        make_contrast_df(d[["b_difficulty_3Easy"]] - d[["b_difficulty_3Hard"]], "Easy - Hard (v)")
    )
    a_contrasts <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      if (has_a_hard) make_contrast_df(d[["b_bs_difficulty_3Hard"]], "Hard - Standard (a)"),
      if (has_a_easy) make_contrast_df(d[["b_bs_difficulty_3Easy"]], "Easy - Standard (a)"),
      if (has_a_hard && has_a_easy)
        make_contrast_df(d[["b_bs_difficulty_3Easy"]] - d[["b_bs_difficulty_3Hard"]], "Easy - Hard (a)")
    )

    plot_posterior_contrasts <- function(df, title, fill_col) {
      hdi_tbl <- df %>%
        dplyr::group_by(contrast) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(lo = quantile(diff, 0.025), hi = quantile(diff, 0.975),
                         med = median(diff), .groups = "drop")
      ggplot(df, aes(x = diff, fill = contrast)) +
        geom_density(alpha = 0.75, color = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
        geom_segment(data = hdi_tbl,
                     aes(x = lo, xend = hi, y = -Inf, yend = -Inf),
                     color = "black", linewidth = 1.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
        geom_point(data = hdi_tbl, aes(x = med, y = 0),
                   shape = 21, fill = "white", color = "black", size = 1.3,
                   inherit.aes = FALSE) +
        facet_wrap(~ contrast, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
        scale_fill_brewer(palette = fill_col, guide = "none") +
        labs(x = "Posterior difference (link scale)", y = "Density", title = title) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
        theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
              strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
              panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
              plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))
    }

    if (nrow(v_contrasts) > 0 && nrow(a_contrasts) > 0) {
      library(patchwork)
      p_v <- plot_posterior_contrasts(v_contrasts, "Drift rate (v) contrasts", "Blues")
      p_a <- plot_posterior_contrasts(a_contrasts, "Boundary separation (a) contrasts", "Reds")
      print(p_v / p_a)
    } else {
      message("Not enough contrast draws available.")
      invisible(NULL)
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Difficulty posterior contrasts failed: ", e$message)
    invisible(NULL)
  })
} else {
  message("Model or required packages not found; skipping difficulty contrast plot.")
  invisible(NULL)
}
```


Exploratory choice-history and within-session fatigue models are reported in Appendix A10. They help interpret the primary effort effects but do not directly test H1-H4 or the pupil-linked analysis.
