### Fixed effects and model comparison {.unnumbered .unlisted}

Nested-model LOO for the primary Decision-Response AUC window (Models m0–m3) appears in @tbl-pupil-loo-unified; key pupil-linked coefficients are in @tbl-pupil-key-effects-appendix.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pupil-key-effects-appendix
#| tbl-cap: !expr paste0("Key pupil effects on drift ($v$) and bias ($z$) (link scale). Posterior mean, 95% CrI, whether the interval includes zero, and $P(\\\\beta > 0)$ for difficulty-conditional slopes (from interaction model).", if (!is.null(pupil_slopes_note)) paste0(" ", pupil_slopes_note) else "")
#| tbl-pos: "htbp"

pupil_key_terms_file <- file.path(proj_root, "output", "pupil_ddm", "tables", "pupil_effects_key_terms.csv")
if (!file.exists(pupil_key_terms_file)) {
  pupil_key_terms_file <- file.path(proj_root, "output", "ddm_pupil", "tables", "pupil_effects_key_terms.csv")
}

if (file.exists(pupil_key_terms_file)) {
  pupil_key_terms <- read_csv(pupil_key_terms_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cn <- names(pupil_key_terms)
  est_col <- intersect(c("Estimate", "estimate", "mean"), cn)[1]
  q2_col <- intersect(c("Q2.5", "q2.5", "q_2.5"), cn)[1]
  q97_col <- intersect(c("Q97.5", "q97.5", "q_97.5"), cn)[1]
  term_col <- intersect(c("term", "parameter", "Parameter"), cn)[1]
  if (is.na(est_col)) est_col <- cn[1]
  if (is.na(term_col)) term_col <- cn[1]
  if (!is.na(q2_col) && !is.na(q97_col) && q2_col %in% cn && q97_col %in% cn) {
    pupil_key_terms_display <- pupil_key_terms %>%
      mutate(
        mean = round(.data[[est_col]], 3),
        `95% CrI` = paste0("[", round(.data[[q2_col]], 3), ", ", round(.data[[q97_col]], 3), "]"),
        `Includes 0` = ifelse(.data[[q2_col]] <= 0 & .data[[q97_col]] >= 0, "Yes", "No"),
        p_gt0 = NA_real_,
        term_display = case_when(
          "dpar" %in% cn & .data[["dpar"]] == "v" ~ "Pupil $v$",
          "dpar" %in% cn & .data[["dpar"]] == "bias" ~ "Pupil $z$",
          grepl("drift", .data[[term_col]], ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("bias", .data[[term_col]], ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Pupil $v$",
          grepl("bias", .data[[term_col]], ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Pupil $z$",
          TRUE ~ as.character(.data[[term_col]])
        )
      ) %>%
      group_by(term_display) %>%
      slice(1) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      arrange(factor(term_display, levels = c("Pupil $v$", "Pupil $z$"))) %>%
      select(term_display, mean, `95% CrI`, `Includes 0`, p_gt0) %>%
      rename(Parameter = term_display)
    if (!is.na(p_gt0_easy) && !is.na(p_gt0_hard) && !is.na(p_gt0_standard)) {
      diff_rows <- tibble::tibble(
        Parameter = c("Pupil $v$: Standard", "Pupil $v$: Hard", "Pupil $v$: Easy"),
        mean = c(round(pupil_diff_mean_std, 3), round(pupil_diff_mean_hard, 3), round(pupil_diff_mean_easy, 3)),
        `95% CrI` = c(pupil_diff_ci_std, pupil_diff_ci_hard, pupil_diff_ci_easy),
        `Includes 0` = c(
          if (isTRUE(pupil_includes_zero_std)) "Yes" else "No",
          if (isTRUE(pupil_includes_zero_hard)) "Yes" else "No",
          if (isTRUE(pupil_includes_zero_easy)) "Yes" else "No"
        ),
        p_gt0 = c(p_gt0_standard, p_gt0_hard, p_gt0_easy)
      )
      pupil_key_terms_display <- dplyr::bind_rows(pupil_key_terms_display, diff_rows)
    }
    pupil_key_terms_display <- pupil_key_terms_display %>%
      mutate(p_gt0_fmt = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(p_gt0) ~ NA_character_,
        round(p_gt0, 3) >= 0.999 ~ "> .999",
        round(p_gt0, 3) <= 0.001 ~ "< .001",
        TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_gt0)
      )) %>%
      select(Parameter, mean, `95% CrI`, `Includes 0`, p_gt0_fmt)
  } else {
    pupil_key_terms_display <- pupil_key_terms %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
  }
  kbl_args <- list(
    format = ifelse(knitr::is_latex_output(), "latex", "html"),
    booktabs = TRUE,
    linesep = "",
    digits = 3
  )
  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
    kbl_args$escape <- FALSE
    if (ncol(pupil_key_terms_display) == 5) {
      kbl_args$col.names <- c("Parameter", "Mean", "95\\% CrI", "Includes 0", "$P(\\beta > 0)$")
    }
  } else if (ncol(pupil_key_terms_display) == 5) {
    kbl_args$col.names <- c("Parameter", "Mean", "95% CrI", "Includes 0", "P(beta > 0)")
  }
  do.call(knitr::kable, c(list(pupil_key_terms_display), kbl_args)) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"),
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
      full_width = FALSE
    )
} else {
  tibble(Note = "Pupil key effects not available. See @sec-pupil-ddm-integration.") %>%
    knitr::kable(format = ifelse(knitr::is_latex_output(), "latex", "html"), booktabs = TRUE) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position", full_width = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pupil-boundary-appendix

pupil_boundary_rows <- list()

    kbl_args$col.names <- c(
      "Window", "N trials",
      "Pupil $\\rightarrow a$ $\\beta$",

    kbl_args$col.names <- c(
      "Window", "N trials",
```

### TEPR descriptives and visualization {.unnumbered .unlisted}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-tepr
#| tbl-cap: "Task-Evoked Pupil Response (TEPR) by Condition"
#| tbl-pos: "htbp"
if (!is.null(pupil_data) && "cognitive_auc" %in% names(pupil_data) && "task" %in% names(pupil_data) && "effort_condition" %in% names(pupil_data) && "difficulty_level" %in% names(pupil_data)) {
  tepr_summary <- pupil_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(cognitive_auc), !is.na(task), !is.na(effort_condition), !is.na(difficulty_level)) %>%
    group_by(task, difficulty_level, effort_condition, subject_id) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_cog_auc = mean(cognitive_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(task, difficulty_level, effort_condition) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_auc = round(mean(mean_cog_auc, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      sd_auc = round(sd(mean_cog_auc, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      n_subjects = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Task_Group = case_when(
        task == "ADT" ~ "ADT",
        task == "VDT" ~ "VDT",
        TRUE ~ task
      ),
      Difficulty = case_when(
        difficulty_level == "Standard" ~ "Standard",
        difficulty_level == "Easy" ~ "Easy",
        difficulty_level == "Hard" ~ "Hard",
        TRUE ~ difficulty_level
      ),
      Effort = case_when(
        effort_condition == "Low_5_MVC" ~ "Low (5% MVC)",
        effort_condition == "High_40_MVC" ~ "High (40% MVC)",
        TRUE ~ effort_condition
      ),
      `Mean AUC` = mean_auc,
      `SD AUC` = sd_auc,
      `N Subjects` = n_subjects
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Task_Group = gsub("–", "-", Task_Group),
      Difficulty = gsub("–", "-", Difficulty),
      Effort = gsub("–", "-", Effort)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Task_Group, Difficulty, Effort) %>%
    select(Task_Group, Difficulty, Effort, `Mean AUC`, `SD AUC`, `N Subjects`)
  tepr_summary %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "Task_Group") %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c(`Mean AUC`, `SD AUC`), decimals = 3) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = `N Subjects`, decimals = 0) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_column_labels()
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold", style = "italic"),
      locations = cells_row_groups()
    ) %>%
    tab_options(
      row_group.as_column = FALSE,
      row_group.padding = px(8)
    ) %>%
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = "TEPR quantified as Decision-Response AUC (4.65–7.65 s relative to handgrip onset; 0.3–3.3 s post-probe). Units: AU·s.",
      locations = cells_column_labels(columns = `Mean AUC`)
    )
} else {
  tibble(Note = "TEPR data not available.") %>%
    gt()
}
```

### TEPR waveforms and conditional slopes {.unnumbered .unlisted}

```{r}
#| label: fig-tepr-timecourse-supp
#| fig-cap: "**Supplementary Figure (Appendix A5).** Task-Evoked Pupil Response (TEPR) time course. Baseline-corrected pupil traces are estimated from winsorized subject-level means, aggregated to condition $\\times$ time grand means, re-anchored to squeeze onset ($t = 0$), downsampled to 200 time samples, and smoothed with a GAM (95% CI on the smooth). Traces are shown for four conditions (Easy/Low, Easy/High, Hard/Low, Hard/High), separately for ADT (top) and VDT (bottom). The shaded region marks the Decision-Response AUC window (4.65–7.65 s relative to squeeze onset). Vertical dashed markers: motor onset (0 s), probe (4.35 s), response cue (4.7 s)."
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-pos: "htbp"
#| out-width: "90%"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| echo: false
p_tepr_out <- NULL
if (!is.null(pupil_data)) {
  # Prefer subject-level waveform means: one row per subject x condition x time.
  # Lines and SEM ribbons reflect between-subject uncertainty at each time sample.
  waveform_subject_file <- c(
    file.path(proj_root, "data/pupil_processed/analysis/pupil_waveforms_subject_condition_mean.csv"),
    file.path(proj_root, "quick_share_v7/analysis/pupil_waveforms_subject_condition_mean.csv")
  )
  waveform_subject_file <- waveform_subject_file[file.exists(waveform_subject_file)][1]

  # Legacy condition-only waveform file, retained only as a render fallback.
  waveform_condition_file <- c(
    file.path(proj_root, "data/pupil_processed/analysis/pupil_waveforms_condition_mean.csv"),
    file.path(proj_root, "quick_share_v7/analysis/pupil_waveforms_condition_mean.csv")
  )
  waveform_condition_file <- waveform_condition_file[file.exists(waveform_condition_file)][1]

  if (!is.na(waveform_subject_file) && file.exists(waveform_subject_file)) {
    waveform_data <- read_csv(waveform_subject_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
    waveform_source <- "subject"
  } else if (!is.na(waveform_condition_file) && file.exists(waveform_condition_file)) {
    waveform_data <- read_csv(waveform_condition_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
    waveform_source <- "condition"
    warning(
      "Using legacy condition-level TEPR waveform file. ",
      "Regenerate pupil_waveforms_subject_condition_mean.csv so Figure 18 GAM CIs ",
      "are computed from subject-level means."
    )
  } else {
    waveform_data <- NULL
    waveform_source <- NA_character_
  }

  if (!is.null(waveform_data)) {
    subject_col <- intersect(c("subject_id", "sub"), names(waveform_data))[1]
    
    # Filter to chapter 3 data and keep all 4 conditions (effort × difficulty)
    waveform_ch3 <- waveform_data %>%
      filter(chapter == "ch3")

    if ("condition" %in% names(waveform_ch3) && any(!is.na(waveform_ch3$condition))) {
      # Subject-level waveform export already carries Easy/Hard x Low/High labels.
      waveform_ch3 <- waveform_ch3 %>%
        mutate(condition = gsub("–", "-", condition))
    } else {
      # Legacy condition-mean file: derive labels from trial metadata columns.
      waveform_ch3 <- waveform_ch3 %>%
        mutate(
          difficulty_level = case_when(
            isOddball == 0 | (is.na(isOddball) & (!is.na(stimulus_intensity) & stimulus_intensity == 0)) ~ "Standard",
            !is.na(stimulus_intensity) & stimulus_intensity %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Hard",
            !is.na(stimulus_intensity) & stimulus_intensity %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Easy",
            isOddball == 1 & is.na(stimulus_intensity) ~ "Easy",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
          ),
          effort_level = case_when(
            effort == "Low" | effort == "Low_Force_5pct" ~ "Low",
            effort == "High" | effort == "High_Force_40pct" ~ "High",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
          ),
          condition = case_when(
            !is.na(difficulty_level) & !is.na(effort_level) ~
              paste0(difficulty_level, " / ", effort_level),
            TRUE ~ "Unknown"
          )
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          difficulty_level = gsub("–", "-", difficulty_level),
          effort_level = gsub("–", "-", effort_level),
          condition = gsub("–", "-", condition)
        )
    }

    waveform_ch3 <- waveform_ch3 %>%
      # Filter out Standard trials (we want Easy/Hard only) and Unknown
      filter(condition != "Unknown", !grepl("Standard", condition)) %>%
      # Use mean_pupil_full (baseline-corrected, B0-corrected) - this converges at 0 in baseline period
      # Per plot_pupil_waveforms.R line 134: mean_pupil_full is the B0-corrected (full baseline correction)
      rename(mean_pupil_isolated = mean_pupil_full) %>%
      filter(!is.na(task), !is.na(condition), !is.na(t_rel), !is.na(mean_pupil_isolated)) %>%
      arrange(task, condition, t_rel)

    tepr_gam_k <- 10L
    tepr_gam_n_timepoints <- 200L
    cognitive_auc_end <- 7.65

    if (!is.na(subject_col)) {
      source(file.path(proj_root, "R", "tepr_waveform_helpers.R"))

      plot_prep <- prepare_tepr_plot_data(
        waveform_ch3 %>% rename(mean_pupil_full = mean_pupil_isolated),
        value_col = "mean_pupil_full",
        winsorize = TRUE
      )
      waveform_ch3 <- prepare_tepr_gam_plot_data(
        plot_prep,
        x_range = c(-0.5, cognitive_auc_end),
        n_timepoints = tepr_gam_n_timepoints
      )
    } else {
      # Legacy condition-level files have already collapsed over subjects, so
      # no subject-level CI can be recovered from them.
      waveform_ch3 <- waveform_ch3 %>%
        group_by(task, condition, t_rel) %>%
        summarise(
          total_trials = sum(n_trials, na.rm = TRUE),
          mean_pupil_isolated = sum(mean_pupil_isolated * n_trials, na.rm = TRUE) / total_trials,
          n_trials = total_trials,
          .groups = "drop"
        )
    }
    
    if (nrow(waveform_ch3) > 0) {
      # Define event markers and Decision-Response AUC window
      # Based on Methods section: Decision-Response AUC window is 4.65s to 7.65s (300ms post-probe until 3.3s post-probe)
      trial_start <- 0.0  # Trial start (squeeze onset)
      target_onset <- 4.35  # Probe stimulus onset
      response_signal_onset <- 4.7  # Response cue prompt
      cognitive_auc_start <- 4.65  # 300ms after probe onset (4.35 + 0.3)
      cognitive_auc_end <- 7.65  # 3.3s post-probe (4.35 + 3.3), corresponding to the Decision-Response AUC window
      
      # Get conditions actually present in data
      conditions_present <- unique(waveform_ch3$condition)
      conditions_present <- conditions_present[!is.na(conditions_present)]
      colors_for_plot <- cond_colors_spaced[names(cond_colors_spaced) %in% conditions_present]
      if (length(colors_for_plot) == 0) {
        # Fallback: use default colors if no matches
        colors_for_plot <- scales::hue_pal()(length(conditions_present))
        names(colors_for_plot) <- conditions_present
      }
      
      gam_curves <- fit_tepr_gam_curves(
        waveform_ch3,
        gam_k = tepr_gam_k,
        x_range = c(-0.5, cognitive_auc_end)
      )

      y_limits <- tepr_gam_curves_ylimits(
        gam_curves,
        x_range = c(-0.5, cognitive_auc_end)
      )
      y_lower_limit <- y_limits[1]
      y_upper_limit <- y_limits[2]
      y_range_span <- y_upper_limit - y_lower_limit
      
      # Event markers with staggered y positions to avoid overlap (vertical text)
      event_markers <- tibble(
        event = c("Trial Start", "Target", "Response"),
        time = c(trial_start, target_onset, response_signal_onset),
        label_y = y_upper_limit - y_range_span * c(0.05, 0.10, 0.15)  # Stagger vertically
      )

      # Create plot
      p_tepr <- ggplot(gam_curves, aes(x = t_rel, y = fit,
                                         color = condition, fill = condition)) +
        # Decision-Response AUC window shading
        geom_rect(aes(xmin = cognitive_auc_start, xmax = cognitive_auc_end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey90", alpha = 0.3) +
        geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = fit_lo, ymax = fit_hi), alpha = 0.25, color = NA) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.95) +
        # Event markers (vertical dashed lines)
        geom_vline(data = event_markers, aes(xintercept = time), 
                   inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
        # Event labels (vertical text to avoid overlap)
        geom_text(data = event_markers, aes(x = time, y = label_y, label = event),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE, angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.9,
                  size = 3.5, color = "grey20", fontface = "bold") +
        # Facet by task (stacked vertically)
        facet_wrap(~task, ncol = 1, labeller = labeller(task = c("ADT" = "ADT", 
                                                                  "VDT" = "VDT"))) +
        # Scales
        scale_color_manual(values = colors_for_plot, name = "Condition") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = colors_for_plot, name = "Condition") +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-0.5, 8, 1), expand = c(0, 0.1)) +
        coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_lower_limit, y_upper_limit)) +
        # Labels and theme
        labs(
          x = "Time (s, relative to squeeze onset)",
          y = "Baseline-Corrected Pupil Diameter (AU)",
          title = NULL
        ) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
        theme(
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
        )
      
      p_tepr_out <- p_tepr
      save_manuscript_fig(p_tepr, "fig_tepr_timecourse", 10, 8)
    }
  }
}
appendix_emit_figure(p_tepr_out, "TEPR time course")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-tepr-slopes-supp
#| fig-cap: !expr pupil_fig_caption
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-pos: "htbp"
#| out-width: "90%"
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| echo: false
p_tepr_slopes_out <- NULL
pupil_int_model_path <- file.path(
  proj_root, params$run_dir, "models",
  "pupil_interaction__probe_onset_locked__thr0.20.rds"
)

if (file.exists(pupil_int_model_path) &&
    requireNamespace("brms", quietly = TRUE)) {

  fit_pupil_int <- tryCatch(readRDS(pupil_int_model_path), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (!is.null(fit_pupil_int) && inherits(fit_pupil_int, "brmsfit")) {
    draws_int <- tryCatch({
      all_draws <- brms::as_draws_df(fit_pupil_int)
      nn <- names(all_draws)
      # Find main slope (Standard reference): brms may prefix with b_mu_ for Wiener family
      std_c <- intersect(c("b_pupil_scaled", "b_mu_pupil_scaled"), nn)[1]
      if (is.na(std_c)) stop("No pupil_scaled main-effect column found in draws")
      # Find interaction columns: must contain pupil_scaled AND the difficulty level
      # Exclude bs/ndt/bias dpars and random-effect draws
      hard_c <- grep("pupil_scaled.*[Hh]ard|[Hh]ard.*pupil_scaled", nn, value = TRUE)
      hard_c <- hard_c[!grepl("^b_bs_|^b_ndt_|^b_bias_|sd_|cor_|r_", hard_c)][1]
      easy_c <- grep("pupil_scaled.*[Ee]asy|[Ee]asy.*pupil_scaled", nn, value = TRUE)
      easy_c <- easy_c[!grepl("^b_bs_|^b_ndt_|^b_bias_|sd_|cor_|r_", easy_c)][1]
      message(sprintf("[fig-pupil-drift] std=%s | hard=%s | easy=%s",
                      std_c,
                      if (is.na(hard_c)) "NOT FOUND" else hard_c,
                      if (is.na(easy_c)) "NOT FOUND" else easy_c))
      if (!is.na(hard_c)) message(sprintf(
        "[fig-pupil-drift] Raw interaction Hard term mean: %.4f", mean(all_draws[[hard_c]])))
      if (!is.na(easy_c)) message(sprintf(
        "[fig-pupil-drift] Raw interaction Easy term mean: %.4f", mean(all_draws[[easy_c]])))
      # Build difficulty-conditional slopes: Standard = main; Hard/Easy = main + interaction
      std_draws  <- all_draws[[std_c]]
      hard_draws <- if (!is.na(hard_c)) std_draws + all_draws[[hard_c]] else std_draws
      easy_draws <- if (!is.na(easy_c)) std_draws + all_draws[[easy_c]] else std_draws
      message(sprintf("[fig-pupil-drift] Conditional slope means: Std=%.4f Hard=%.4f Easy=%.4f",
                      mean(std_draws), mean(hard_draws), mean(easy_draws)))
      tibble::tibble(
        difficulty = factor(
          rep(c("Standard", "Hard", "Easy"), each = length(std_draws)),
          levels = c("Standard", "Hard", "Easy")
        ),
        slope = c(std_draws, hard_draws, easy_draws)
      )
    }, error = function(e) { message("draws extraction failed: ", e$message); NULL })

    if (!is.null(draws_int) && nrow(draws_int) > 0) {
      # Compute 95% quantile intervals per difficulty level
      hdi_int <- draws_int %>%
        dplyr::group_by(difficulty) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          lo  = quantile(slope, 0.025),
          hi  = quantile(slope, 0.975),
          med = median(slope),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      p_pupil_interact <- ggplot(draws_int, aes(x = slope)) +
        geom_density(aes(fill = difficulty), alpha = 0.75, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
        geom_segment(
          data = hdi_int,
          aes(x = lo, xend = hi, y = -Inf, yend = -Inf),
          color = "black", linewidth = 1.2
        ) +
        geom_point(
          data = hdi_int,
          aes(x = med, y = 0),
          shape = 21, fill = "white", color = "black", size = 1.5
        ) +
        facet_wrap(~ difficulty, nrow = 1) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = diff_colors, guide = "none") +
        labs(
          x = "Posterior slope: pupil_scaled on drift rate (v)",
          y = "Posterior density"
        ) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
        theme(
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
          strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
        )
      p_tepr_slopes_out <- p_pupil_interact
      save_manuscript_fig(p_pupil_interact, "fig_pupil_drift_difficulty_interaction", 9, 3.5)
    } else {
      message("Pupil interaction draws could not be extracted.")
    }
  } else {
    message("Pupil interaction model not available (NULL or non-brmsfit).")
  }
} else {
  message("Pupil interaction model file or brms package not found; skipping figure.")
}
appendix_emit_figure(p_tepr_slopes_out, "TEPR slopes on drift")
```

## A6. Detailed DDM Model Specification {#sec-appendix-a6 .unnumbered}

Full model equations, priors, and sampling details omitted from the main Methods.

### A6.1 Response-Signal Timing Structure {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| label: fig-timing-supp
#| fig-cap: "Structural schematic of a single trial timeline and task-evoked pupil response (TEPR) integration windows. The full timeline is anchored to initial somatic contraction (Squeeze Onset at 0.00 s). Perceptual evidence becomes available at Probe Onset (4.35 s), followed by the execution prompt (Response Prompt at 4.70 s). Phasic arousal features are extracted using two baseline-corrected windows opening at 4.65 s (probe onset + 300 ms neurophysiological lag). The primary Decision-Response AUC window spans a full 3.0 seconds to capture the complete late-peaking morphology of the older cohort's pupillary response, intentionally encompassing both choice formation and post-decisional processing. The Truncated Decision-Response AUC window spans 1.0 second (0.3–1.3 s post-probe), evaluated in a sensitivity refit of the nested pupil-DDM models (@sec-pupil-ddm-integration)."
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-pos: "htbp"
#| out-width: "70%"
include_graphics_safe(fig_path("AUC_timeline_v2.png"))
```

Primary analyses used probe-onset-locked RT. @fig-rt-distributions shows the ~0.35 s shift from cue-locked RT. Cue-locked RT is used only in sensitivity checks (Appendix A4.2).

```{r}
#| label: fig-rt-distributions
#| fig-cap: "RT Timing Convention Validation. Histograms showing the distribution of response times for cue-locked (measured from response-window onset) and probe-onset-locked (measured from probe stimulus onset) RT definitions across all trials. The probe-onset distribution is shifted rightward by approximately 0.35 s, corresponding to the fixed post-probe delay before the response window opens. This shift validates correct implementation of the timing transformation described in Methods. All primary analyses use probe-onset-locked RT."
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-pos: "htbp"
#| out-width: "70%"
library(ggplot2)
rt_data_file <- file.path("data", "ddm_ready_data_unthresholded.csv")
if (file.exists(rt_data_file)) {
  rt_data <- read_csv(rt_data_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  rt_cue_col <- if ("rt_cue_locked" %in% names(rt_data)) "rt_cue_locked" else "rt"
  rt_plot_data <- rt_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(rt_cue_col)), !is.na(rt_probe_onset_locked)) %>%
    mutate(

      probe_onset_locked = rt_probe_onset_locked
    ) %>%
    select(cue_locked, probe_onset_locked) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "rt_type", values_to = "rt") %>%

      )
    ) %>%
    filter(rt > 0, rt < 5)
  p_rt_dist <- ggplot(rt_plot_data, aes(x = rt, fill = rt_type)) +
```

### A6.2 Link Functions and Parameter Constraints {.unnumbered}

**Link functions**: To ensure parameter constraints, we apply link functions [@ratcliff2002estimating; @burkner2017brms]. The model was implemented using the `brms` package with `family = wiener(link_bs="log", link_ndt="log", link_bias="logit")`: drift rate $v = \beta_v$ (identity link); boundary separation $a = \exp(\beta_{\text{bs}})$ (log link, ensures $a > 0$); non-decision time $t_0 = \exp(\beta_{\text{ndt}})$ (log link, ensures $t_0 > 0$); starting-point bias $z = \text{logit}^{-1}(\beta_{\text{bias}}) = \frac{\exp(\beta_{\text{bias}})}{1 + \exp(\beta_{\text{bias}})}$ (logit link, ensures $z \in [0,1]$).

### A6.3 Hierarchical Model Structure {.unnumbered}

For subject $i$, trial $j$ [@burkner2017brms; @ratcliff2008diffusion]:

$$v_{ij} = \beta_{v,0} + \sum_k \beta_{v,k} X_{k,ij} + u_{v,i}$$ {#eq-drift-hierarchical}

$$a_{ij} = \exp\left(\beta_{\text{bs},0} + \sum_k \beta_{\text{bs},k} X_{k,ij} + u_{\text{bs},i}\right)$$ {#eq-boundary-hierarchical}

$$t_{0,ij} = \exp\left(\beta_{\text{ndt},0} + \sum_k \beta_{\text{ndt},k} X_{k,ij}\right)$$ {#eq-ndt-hierarchical}

$$z_{ij} = \text{logit}^{-1}\left(\beta_{\text{bias},0} + \sum_k \beta_{\text{bias},k} X_{k,ij} + u_{\text{bias},i}\right)$$ {#eq-bias-hierarchical}

where $\beta_{0}$ are intercepts, $\beta_k$ are coefficients for predictors $X_k$, and $u_i \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2_u)$ are subject random effects. $t_0$ has no subject random effects (response-signal design).

**Likelihood**: The likelihood for a single trial with RT $t$ and decision $d \in \{\text{"same"}, \text{"different"}\}$ follows the Wiener first-passage time distribution [@feller1968introduction]:

$$p(t, d | v, a, t_0, z) = \text{Wiener}(t - t_0 | v, a, z)$$ {#eq-likelihood}

where the Wiener distribution gives the probability density of the first-passage time to boundary $d$ given drift $v$, boundary separation $a$, and starting point $z \cdot a$.

Standard-only model formulas (one `brms` `bf()` call): drift `rt | dec(dec_upper) ~ 1 + (1|subject_id)` (prior N(0, 2)); boundary `bs ~ 1 + (1|subject_id)`; ndt `ndt ~ 1`; bias `bias ~ task + effort_condition + (1|subject_id)`.

@fig-ddm-dag-plate summarizes the response-signal design (Panel A) and hierarchical generative model (Panel B).

```{r}
#| label: fig-ddm-dag-plate
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Causal assumptions and generative structure for the hierarchical DDM. Panel A shows a conceptual causal DAG in which Age and experimentally manipulated task factors (difficulty, modality, effort) influence latent DDM parameters under a gated-response design; the wait constraint alters the mapping from decision completion to observed RT, and trial selection S represents RT-based exclusions. Panel B shows the corresponding hierarchical generative structure: subject-level parameters $v_i$, $a_i$, $T_{er,i}$ are depicted as influenced by a generic subject-level covariate (e.g., Age_i), while in the present chapter age is not explicitly modeled because all participants are older adults; trial-level predictors $X_{it}$ (difficulty, modality, effort) modulate drift, and choices and RTs are generated from these parameters."
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-pos: "htbp"
#| out-width: "75%"
include_graphics_safe(fig_path("fig-ddm-dag-plate-2.png"))
```


The complete `brms` formula syntax for the standard-only calibration model is:

```r
bf(rt | dec(dec_upper) ~ 1 + (1 | subject_id),
   bs ~ task + effort_condition + (1 | subject_id),
   ndt ~ 1,
   bias ~ task + effort_condition + (1 | subject_id),
   family = wiener(link_bs = "log",
                   link_ndt = "log",
                   link_bias = "logit"))
```

The complete `brms` formula syntax for the primary additive model is:

```r
bf(rt | dec(dec_upper) ~ difficulty_level + effort_condition +
                          (1 | subject_id),
   bs ~ difficulty_level + effort_condition + (1 | subject_id),
   ndt ~ 1,
   bias ~ task + effort_condition + (1 | subject_id),
   family = wiener(link_bs = "log",
                   link_ndt = "log",
                   link_bias = "logit"))
```

where `dec(dec_upper)` encodes the response boundary (1 = *different*, 0 = *same*), `bs` is the log-link parameter for boundary separation $a$, `ndt` is the log-link parameter for non-decision time $t_0$, and `bias` is the logit-link parameter for starting-point $z$.

### A6.4 Prior Specification {.unnumbered}

All priors were weakly informative and specified on the link scale. For intercepts, drift rate ($v$) used Normal(0, 1); boundary separation ($a$) used Normal(log(1.3), 0.25), corresponding to $a \approx 1.3$ on the natural scale; non-decision time ($t_0$) used Normal(log(0.35), 0.15), corresponding to $t_0 \approx 0.35$ s on the natural scale (probe-onset-locked timing; the cue-locked variant used Normal(log(0.10), 0.15)); and starting-point bias ($z$) used Normal(0, 0.5), corresponding to $z \approx 0.5$ (no bias) on the probability scale. For slope parameters, drift rate slopes used Normal(0, 0.6–0.7), boundary separation slopes used Normal(0, 0.25–0.30), and bias slopes used Normal(0, 0.35). Random effects were assigned Student-t(3, 0, 0.30) priors for standard deviations and LKJ(2) priors for correlations. Prior vs. posterior for $t_0$: @fig-ndt-prior-posterior (A1).

### A6.5 Computational Details {.unnumbered}

**Software.** R [@R], `brms` [@burkner2017brms; @burkner2018brms], CmdStan [@cmdstan2024] via `cmdstanr` [@cmdstanr], `loo` [@vehtari2017loo], tidyverse [@dplyr; @tidyr; @readr; @wickham2016ggplot2], `gt` [@gt], `posterior` [@burkner2022posterior], `RWiener` [@wabersich2014rwiener], `bayesplot` [@gabry2019bayesplot], Quarto [@quarto]. Models fit on GCP.

**MCMC.** NUTS [@hoffman2014nuts], 8 chains × 2000 iterations (1000 warmup), adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12. Convergence: $\hat{R}$ $\leq$ 1.01, bulk ESS $\geq$ 400, zero divergences. Primary additive model: max $\hat{R}$ < 1.01, min bulk ESS = `r if (!is.null(conv_min_bulk_primary) && !is.na(conv_min_bulk_primary)) sprintf("%.0f", conv_min_bulk_primary) else "745"`, zero divergences.

**PSIS.** Pareto-$k > 0.7$ flagged per [@vehtari2017loo].

Model comparison and PPC: Appendix A1 and A3.


## A7. Manipulation Checks: Behavioral Validation {#sec-appendix-a7 .unnumbered}

Mixed-effects checks on accuracy and RT (Easy and Hard trials only). Reported for validation; DDM results do not depend on them.

### A7.1 Methods {.unnumbered}

GLMM (binomial) for accuracy; LMM for median cue-locked RT per subject-condition. Fixed effects: difficulty, effort, task (with interactions as needed); random intercepts by subject. Standard trials excluded. Fitted in `lme4` [@bates2015lme4]; tables from `broom.mixed` [@broommixed].

```{r mc-sample-size}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
# Compute manipulation checks sample size for inline use
n_trials_mc <- 13771L
if (!is.null(behavioral_data)) {
  diff_col <- intersect(c("difficulty_level", "difficulty"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
  if (!is.null(diff_col)) {
    mc_data_count <- behavioral_data %>%
      filter(tolower(as.character(!!sym(diff_col))) %in% c("easy", "hard"))
    n_trials_mc <- nrow(mc_data_count)
  }
}
```

### A7.2 Accuracy Results {.unnumbered}

Easy and Hard trials only (N = `r format(n_trials_mc, big.mark = ",")`).

```{r}
#| include: false
# Compute accuracy means for narrative (same data as Figure 7 and GLMM)
acc_means_for_narrative <- NULL
acc_hard_min <- 26.4
acc_hard_mean <- 30.5
acc_easy_mean <- 85.2
acc_high_mean <- 56.8
acc_low_mean <- 58.5
if (!is.null(behavioral_data)) {
  acc_col <- intersect(c("correct", "iscorr", "accuracy"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
  diff_col <- intersect(c("difficulty_level", "difficulty"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
  effort_col <- intersect(c("effort_condition", "effort"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
  task_col <- intersect(c("task", "Task"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
  if (!is.null(acc_col) && !is.null(diff_col)) {
    mc_data <- behavioral_data %>%
      filter(tolower(as.character(!!sym(diff_col))) %in% c("easy", "hard"))
    if (nrow(mc_data) > 0) {
      acc_means_for_narrative <- mc_data %>%
        mutate(diff = ifelse(tolower(as.character(!!sym(diff_col))) == "easy", "Easy", "Hard")) %>%
        group_by(diff) %>%
        summarise(mean_acc = mean(!!sym(acc_col), na.rm = TRUE) * 100, .groups = "drop")
      acc_hard_mean <- round(acc_means_for_narrative %>% filter(diff == "Hard") %>% pull(mean_acc), 1)
      acc_easy_mean <- round(acc_means_for_narrative %>% filter(diff == "Easy") %>% pull(mean_acc), 1)
      if (!is.null(effort_col) && effort_col %in% names(mc_data)) {
        effort_means <- mc_data %>%
          mutate(effort = tolower(as.character(!!sym(effort_col)))) %>%
          mutate(effort = ifelse(grepl("high|40", effort), "High", "Low")) %>%
          group_by(effort) %>%
          summarise(mean_acc = mean(!!sym(acc_col), na.rm = TRUE) * 100, .groups = "drop")
        acc_high_mean <- round(effort_means %>% filter(effort == "High") %>% pull(mean_acc), 1)
        acc_low_mean <- round(effort_means %>% filter(effort == "Low") %>% pull(mean_acc), 1)
      }
      if (!is.null(effort_col) && effort_col %in% names(mc_data) && !is.null(task_col) && task_col %in% names(mc_data)) {
        hard_cells <- mc_data %>%
          filter(tolower(as.character(!!sym(diff_col))) == "hard") %>%
          group_by(!!sym(task_col), !!sym(effort_col)) %>%
          summarise(mean_acc = mean(!!sym(acc_col), na.rm = TRUE) * 100, .groups = "drop")
        acc_hard_min <- round(min(hard_cells$mean_acc, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
      }
    }
  }
}
acc_hard_beta_str   <- "$\\beta = -2.97$"
acc_hard_ci_str     <- "95\\% CI [−3.07, −2.88]"
acc_effort_beta_str <- "$\\beta = -0.15$"
acc_effort_ci_str   <- "95\\% CI [−0.23, −0.06]"
acc_effort_p_str    <- "$p < .001$"
if (!is.null(acc_glmm) && nrow(acc_glmm) > 0) {
  .acc_hard <- .lmm_term(acc_glmm, "difficulty.*Hard|Hard")
  .acc_eff  <- .lmm_term(acc_glmm, "effort.*High|High_MVC")
  if (!is.null(.acc_hard)) {
    acc_hard_beta_str <- sprintf("$\\beta = %.2f$", .acc_hard$beta)
    acc_hard_ci_str   <- sprintf("95\\%% CI [%.2f, %.2f]", .acc_hard$lo, .acc_hard$hi)
  }
  if (!is.null(.acc_eff)) {
    acc_effort_beta_str <- sprintf("$\\beta = %.2f$", .acc_eff$beta)
    acc_effort_ci_str   <- sprintf("95\\%% CI [%.2f, %.2f]", .acc_eff$lo, .acc_eff$hi)
    .eff_row <- acc_glmm %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data$effect == "fixed",
                    grepl("effort.*High|High_MVC", .data$term, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
      dplyr::slice(1)
    if (nrow(.eff_row) == 1 && "p.value" %in% names(.eff_row)) {
      acc_effort_p_str <- if (.eff_row$p.value < 0.001) {
        "$p < .001$"
      } else {
        sprintf("$p = %.3f$", .eff_row$p.value)
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Hard trials were less accurate than Easy (`r acc_hard_beta_str`, `r acc_hard_ci_str`, $p < .001$; means `r acc_hard_mean`% vs. `r acc_easy_mean`%; @tbl-accuracy-glmm, @fig-accuracy-distribution). Lowest accuracy was in Hard+High cells (`r acc_hard_min`%). High effort reduced accuracy relative to Low (`r acc_effort_beta_str`, `r acc_effort_ci_str`, `r acc_effort_p_str`; `r acc_high_mean`% vs. `r acc_low_mean`%).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-accuracy-glmm
#| tbl-cap: "Accuracy GLMM Results"
if (!is.null(acc_glmm)) {
  # Function to clean up term names for publication (vectorized)
  clean_term_name <- function(term) {
    term <- as.character(term)
    
    # Intercept
    term <- ifelse(term == "(Intercept)", "Intercept", term)
    
    # Step 1: Handle interactions FIRST (on raw R terms)
    # Difficulty × Task interactions
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelEasy:taskVDT", "Difficulty: Easy × Task: VDT", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelEasy:taskADT", "Difficulty: Easy × Task: ADT", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelHard:taskVDT", "Difficulty: Hard × Task: VDT", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelHard:taskADT", "Difficulty: Hard × Task: ADT", term)
    
    # Effort × Task interactions
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionLow_5_MVC:taskVDT", "Effort: Low (5% MVC) × Task: VDT", term)
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionLow_5_MVC:taskADT", "Effort: Low (5% MVC) × Task: ADT", term)
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionHigh_MVC:taskVDT", "Effort: High (40% MVC) × Task: VDT", term)
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionHigh_MVC:taskADT", "Effort: High (40% MVC) × Task: ADT", term)
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionLow:taskVDT", "Effort: Low × Task: VDT", term)
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionLow:taskADT", "Effort: Low × Task: ADT", term)
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionHigh:taskVDT", "Effort: High × Task: VDT", term)
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionHigh:taskADT", "Effort: High × Task: ADT", term)
    
    # Difficulty × Effort interactions
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelEasy:effort_conditionLow_5_MVC", "Difficulty: Easy × Effort: Low (5% MVC)", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelEasy:effort_conditionHigh_MVC", "Difficulty: Easy × Effort: High (40% MVC)", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelHard:effort_conditionLow_5_MVC", "Difficulty: Hard × Effort: Low (5% MVC)", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelHard:effort_conditionHigh_MVC", "Difficulty: Hard × Effort: High (40% MVC)", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelEasy:effort_conditionLow", "Difficulty: Easy × Effort: Low", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelEasy:effort_conditionHigh", "Difficulty: Easy × Effort: High", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelHard:effort_conditionLow", "Difficulty: Hard × Effort: Low", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelHard:effort_conditionHigh", "Difficulty: Hard × Effort: High", term)
    
    # Step 2: Handle main effects (only for terms NOT already processed as interactions)
    # Check if term is NOT already an interaction (doesn't contain ×)
    main_effect_mask <- !grepl(" × ", term)
    
    # Main effects (preserve colons - these separate factor name from level)
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("difficulty_levelEasy", "Difficulty: Easy", term[main_effect_mask])
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("difficulty_levelHard", "Difficulty: Hard", term[main_effect_mask])
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("effort_conditionLow_5_MVC", "Effort: Low", term[main_effect_mask])
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("effort_conditionHigh_MVC", "Effort: High", term[main_effect_mask])
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("effort_conditionLow", "Effort: Low", term[main_effect_mask])
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("effort_conditionHigh", "Effort: High", term[main_effect_mask])
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("taskVDT", "Task: VDT", term[main_effect_mask])
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("taskADT", "Task: ADT", term[main_effect_mask])
    
    # Step 3: For any remaining raw R interactions (not caught above), convert colon to ×
    # Only if term still has raw R format colons (between factor names, not in cleaned format)
    raw_interaction_mask <- grepl("_condition|_level|task", term) & grepl(":", term) & !grepl(" × ", term)
    term[raw_interaction_mask] <- gsub(":", " × ", term[raw_interaction_mask])
    
    return(term)
  }
  
  acc_glmm %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
    mutate(
      term_clean = clean_term_name(term),
      estimate_fmt = sprintf("%.2f", estimate),
      p_value_fmt = ifelse(p.value < .001, "<.001", sprintf("%.3f", p.value)),
      ci_fmt = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", conf.low, conf.high)
    ) %>%
    select(term_clean, estimate_fmt, std.error, statistic, p_value_fmt, ci_fmt) %>%
    rename(term = term_clean) %>%
    gt() %>%
    cols_label(
      term = "Term",
      estimate_fmt = "Estimate",
      std.error = "SE",
      p_value_fmt = "p",
      ci_fmt = "95% CI"
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-accuracy-distribution
#| fig-cap: "Accuracy distribution by condition. Individual subject trajectories (light gray) and group means by effort with approximate 95% CI (mean ± 1.96 SE). Faceted by task and difficulty. Each facet shows cell means (Low vs High effort) within that task × difficulty combination. Narrative text reports marginal mean accuracy across task × effort (Hard vs Easy only); this figure shows cell means for visual inspection. Error bars represent within-subject standard errors calculated using the Cousineau-Morey correction."
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-pos: "htbp"
#| out-width: "85%"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
#| echo: false
p_acc_out <- NULL
if (!is.null(behavioral_data)) {
  # Standardize column names
  acc_col <- intersect(c("correct", "iscorr", "accuracy"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
  task_col <- intersect(c("task", "Task"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
  diff_col <- intersect(c("difficulty_level", "difficulty"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
  effort_col <- intersect(c("effort_condition", "effort"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
  subj_col <- intersect(c("subject_id", "sub"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
  
  if (!is.null(acc_col) && !is.null(task_col) && !is.null(diff_col) && !is.null(effort_col) && !is.null(subj_col)) {
    # Build data_long: subject-level mean accuracy by condition
    data_long <- behavioral_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(!!sym(acc_col))) %>%
      group_by(!!sym(subj_col), !!sym(task_col), !!sym(diff_col), !!sym(effort_col)) %>%
      summarise(mean_acc = mean(!!sym(acc_col), na.rm = TRUE) * 100, .groups = "drop") %>%
      transmute(
        subject_id = as.character(!!sym(subj_col)),
        task = case_when(
          !!sym(task_col) %in% c("ADT", "adt") ~ "ADT",
          !!sym(task_col) %in% c("VDT", "vdt") ~ "VDT",
          TRUE ~ as.character(!!sym(task_col))
        ),
        difficulty = case_when(
          !!sym(diff_col) %in% c("Standard", "standard") ~ "Standard",
          !!sym(diff_col) %in% c("Easy", "easy") ~ "Easy",
          !!sym(diff_col) %in% c("Hard", "hard") ~ "Hard",
          tolower(!!sym(diff_col)) == "easy" ~ "Easy",
          tolower(!!sym(diff_col)) == "hard" ~ "Hard",
          tolower(!!sym(diff_col)) == "standard" ~ "Standard",
          TRUE ~ as.character(!!sym(diff_col))
        ),
        effort = case_when(
          !!sym(effort_col) %in% c("Low_5_MVC", "low", "Low") ~ "Low",
          !!sym(effort_col) %in% c("High_40_MVC", "high", "High") ~ "High",
          TRUE ~ as.character(!!sym(effort_col))
        ),
        accuracy = mean_acc
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        task = factor(task, levels = c("ADT", "VDT")),
        difficulty = factor(difficulty, levels = c("Standard", "Easy", "Hard")),
        effort = factor(effort, levels = c("Low", "High"))
      )

    if (nrow(data_long) > 0) {
      # Cousineau-Morey within-subject SE: for each (task, difficulty), normalize by subject mean
      cm_se_by_cell <- data_long %>%
        group_by(task, difficulty, subject_id) %>%
        mutate(subj_mean = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        group_by(task, difficulty) %>%
        mutate(grand_mean = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(normalized = accuracy - subj_mean + grand_mean) %>%
        group_by(task, difficulty, effort) %>%
        summarise(
          mean_acc = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
          n = n(),
          cm_se = sd(normalized, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n) * sqrt(2 / (2 - 1)),
          .groups = "drop"
        )
      # Diagnostic: compute cell means (as plotted) and marginal means (as in narrative)
      fig7_cell_means <- data_long %>%
        group_by(task, difficulty, effort) %>%
        summarise(mean_acc = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
      fig7_marginal_diff <- data_long %>%
        filter(difficulty %in% c("Hard", "Easy")) %>%
        group_by(difficulty) %>%
        summarise(marginal_mean = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
      p1 <- ggplot(data_long, aes(x = effort, y = accuracy, group = subject_id)) +
        geom_line(alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.3, color = "gray40") +
        geom_point(aes(color = effort), alpha = 0.4, size = 0.9,
                  position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, seed = 42)) +
        stat_summary(aes(group = 1), fun = mean, geom = "line",
                     linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
        stat_summary(aes(group = 1, fill = "Mean"), fun.data = function(x) ggplot2::mean_se(x, mult = 1.96),
                     geom = "ribbon", alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
        geom_errorbar(data = cm_se_by_cell, aes(x = effort, y = mean_acc, ymin = mean_acc - 1.96 * cm_se, ymax = mean_acc + 1.96 * cm_se, group = effort),
                      inherit.aes = FALSE, width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.8, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
        geom_point(data = cm_se_by_cell, aes(x = effort, y = mean_acc, color = effort, group = effort),
                   inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 1,
                   position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
        facet_grid(task ~ difficulty,
                   labeller = labeller(
                     task = c(ADT = "Auditory", VDT = "Visual"),
                     difficulty = c(Standard = "Standard", Easy = "Easy", Hard = "Hard")
                   )) +
        scale_color_manual(values = effort_colors) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("Mean" = "gray30"), guide = "none") +
        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
        labs(x = "Effort Condition", y = "Accuracy (%)", color = "Effort") +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
        theme(
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "gray70"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
          legend.position = "right",
          panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines")
        )
      p_acc_out <- p1
      save_manuscript_fig(p1, "fig_accuracy_distribution", 8, 6)
      # Optional: uncomment to verify figure vs narrative alignment
      # cat("Figure 7 cell means (subject-averaged):\n"); print(fig7_cell_means)
      # cat("Figure 7 marginal by difficulty:\n"); print(fig7_marginal_diff)
    } else {
      message("Accuracy distribution plot: No data available.")
    }
  } else {
    message("Accuracy distribution plot: Required columns not found.")
  }
} else {
  message("Accuracy distribution plot: Behavioral data not available.")
}
appendix_emit_figure(p_acc_out, "Accuracy distribution")
```

```{r overall-accuracy-compute}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
# Compute overall accuracy for inline use (Easy and Hard trials only, and all trials)
overall_acc_mean <- 63.5
overall_acc_sd <- 10.5
overall_acc_min <- 30.6
overall_acc_max <- 92.3
overall_acc_with_standard <- 70.1
if (!is.null(behavioral_data)) {
  acc_col <- intersect(c("correct", "iscorr", "accuracy"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
  diff_col <- intersect(c("difficulty_level", "difficulty"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
  subj_col <- intersect(c("subject_id", "sub"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
  if (!is.null(acc_col) && !is.null(diff_col) && !is.null(subj_col)) {
    # Easy and Hard only
    data_for_acc <- behavioral_data %>%
      filter(.data[[diff_col]] %in% c("Easy", "Hard"))
    overall_acc <- data_for_acc %>%
      group_by(!!sym(subj_col)) %>%
      summarise(accuracy = mean(!!sym(acc_col), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    if (nrow(overall_acc) > 0) {
      overall_acc_mean <- round(mean(overall_acc$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)
      overall_acc_sd <- round(sd(overall_acc$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)
      overall_acc_min <- round(min(overall_acc$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)
      overall_acc_max <- round(max(overall_acc$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)
    }
    # All trials (including Standard)
    overall_acc_all <- behavioral_data %>%
      group_by(!!sym(subj_col)) %>%
      summarise(accuracy = mean(!!sym(acc_col), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    if (nrow(overall_acc_all) > 0) {
      overall_acc_with_standard <- round(mean(overall_acc_all$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)
    }
  }
}
```

Mean subject accuracy on Easy and Hard trials: *M* = `r overall_acc_mean`%, *SD* = `r overall_acc_sd`% (@tbl-overall-accuracy). With Standard trials included, overall accuracy was `r overall_acc_with_standard`%. Range across subjects: `r overall_acc_min`–`r overall_acc_max`%.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-overall-accuracy
#| tbl-cap: "Overall Accuracy Summary for Easy and Hard Trials"
#| tbl-pos: "htbp"
# Overall accuracy for Easy and Hard trials only (Standard excluded)
# Standardize column names for accuracy (needed since tbl-accuracy-by-condition is disabled)
if (!is.null(behavioral_data)) {
  # Standardize column names for accuracy
  if ("correct" %in% names(behavioral_data)) {
    acc_col <- "correct"
  } else if ("iscorr" %in% names(behavioral_data)) {
    acc_col <- "iscorr"
  } else if ("accuracy" %in% names(behavioral_data)) {
    acc_col <- "accuracy"
  } else {
    acc_col <- NULL
  }
  diff_col <- intersect(c("difficulty_level", "difficulty"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
}

if (!is.null(behavioral_data) && !is.null(acc_col)) {
  subj_col <- if ("subject_id" %in% names(behavioral_data)) "subject_id" else if ("sub" %in% names(behavioral_data)) "sub" else NULL
  
  if (!is.null(subj_col)) {
    # Filter to Easy and Hard trials only (exclude Standard)
    data_for_acc <- behavioral_data
    if (!is.na(diff_col) && diff_col %in% names(behavioral_data)) {
      data_for_acc <- behavioral_data %>%
        filter(.data[[diff_col]] %in% c("Easy", "Hard"))
    }
    overall_acc <- data_for_acc %>%
      group_by(!!sym(subj_col)) %>%
      summarise(
        n_trials = n(),
        n_correct = sum(!!sym(acc_col), na.rm = TRUE),
        accuracy = mean(!!sym(acc_col), na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  
    overall_summary <- overall_acc %>%
      summarise(
        n_subjects = n(),
        mean_acc = round(mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
        sd_acc = round(sd(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
        median_acc = round(median(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
        min_acc = round(min(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
        max_acc = round(max(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
        total_trials = sum(n_trials)
      )
    
    overall_summary %>%
      gt() %>%
      cols_label(
        n_subjects = "N Subjects",
        mean_acc = "Mean %",
        sd_acc = "SD %",
        median_acc = "Median %",
        min_acc = "Min %",
        max_acc = "Max %",
        total_trials = "Total Trials"
      ) %>%
      fmt_number(columns = c(mean_acc, sd_acc, median_acc, min_acc, max_acc), decimals = 1) %>%
      fmt_number(columns = c(n_subjects, total_trials), decimals = 0)
  } else {
    # Placeholder if subject column not found
    tibble(
      Metric = c("N Subjects", "Mean Accuracy", "SD", "Median", "Range"),
      Value = c(
        as.character(n_subj_final),
        "To be computed",
        "To be computed",
        "To be computed",
        "To be computed"
      )
    ) %>%
      gt()
  }
} else {
  # Placeholder
  tibble(
    Metric = c("N Subjects", "Mean Accuracy", "SD", "Median", "Range"),

      as.character(n_subj_final),
      "To be computed",
```

### A7.3 Reaction Time Results {.unnumbered}

```{r rt-medians-compute}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
# Compute median RTs for Hard and Easy for inline use
rt_hard_median <- 1.01
rt_easy_median <- 0.75
if (!is.null(behavioral_data)) {
  rt_col <- intersect(c("rt", "resp1RT", "RT"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
  diff_col <- intersect(c("difficulty_level", "difficulty"), names(behavioral_data))[1]
  if (!is.null(rt_col) && !is.null(diff_col)) {
    rt_by_diff <- behavioral_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(!!sym(rt_col)), !!sym(rt_col) > 0) %>%
      filter(tolower(as.character(!!sym(diff_col))) %in% c("easy", "hard")) %>%
      mutate(diff = ifelse(tolower(as.character(!!sym(diff_col))) == "easy", "Easy", "Hard")) %>%
      group_by(diff) %>%
      summarise(median_rt = median(!!sym(rt_col), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    if (nrow(rt_by_diff) > 0) {
      rt_hard_median <- round(rt_by_diff %>% filter(diff == "Hard") %>% pull(median_rt), 2)
      rt_easy_median <- round(rt_by_diff %>% filter(diff == "Easy") %>% pull(median_rt), 2)
    }
  }
}
rt_hard_beta_str <- "$\\beta = 0.232 s$"
rt_hard_ci_str   <- "95\\% CI [0.197, 0.266]"
if (!is.null(rt_lmm) && nrow(rt_lmm) > 0) {
  .rt_hard <- .lmm_term(rt_lmm, "difficulty.*Hard|Hard")
  if (!is.null(.rt_hard)) {
    rt_hard_beta_str <- sprintf("$\\beta = %.3f s$", .rt_hard$beta)
    rt_hard_ci_str   <- sprintf("95\\%% CI [%.3f, %.3f]", .rt_hard$lo, .rt_hard$hi)
  }
}
```

Hard trials were slower than Easy (`r rt_hard_beta_str`, `r rt_hard_ci_str`, $p < .001$; medians `r rt_hard_median` s vs. `r rt_easy_median` s; @tbl-rt-lmm, @fig-rt-distribution). Effort did not affect RT credibly (`r sprintf("$\\beta = %s$", rt_effort_beta_str)`, `r sprintf("95\\%% CI %s", rt_effort_ci_str)`).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-rt-lmm
#| tbl-cap: "RT LMM Results"
if (!is.null(rt_lmm)) {
  # Function to clean up term names for publication (same as accuracy model, vectorized)
  clean_term_name <- function(term) {
    term <- as.character(term)
    
    # Intercept
    term <- ifelse(term == "(Intercept)", "Intercept", term)
    
    # Step 1: Handle interactions FIRST (on raw R terms)
    # Difficulty × Task interactions
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelEasy:taskVDT", "Difficulty: Easy × Task: VDT", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelEasy:taskADT", "Difficulty: Easy × Task: ADT", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelHard:taskVDT", "Difficulty: Hard × Task: VDT", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelHard:taskADT", "Difficulty: Hard × Task: ADT", term)
    
    # Effort × Task interactions
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionLow_5_MVC:taskVDT", "Effort: Low (5% MVC) × Task: VDT", term)
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionLow_5_MVC:taskADT", "Effort: Low (5% MVC) × Task: ADT", term)
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionHigh_MVC:taskVDT", "Effort: High (40% MVC) × Task: VDT", term)
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionHigh_MVC:taskADT", "Effort: High (40% MVC) × Task: ADT", term)
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionLow:taskVDT", "Effort: Low × Task: VDT", term)
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionLow:taskADT", "Effort: Low × Task: ADT", term)
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionHigh:taskVDT", "Effort: High × Task: VDT", term)
    term <- gsub("effort_conditionHigh:taskADT", "Effort: High × Task: ADT", term)
    
    # Difficulty × Effort interactions
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelEasy:effort_conditionLow_5_MVC", "Difficulty: Easy × Effort: Low (5% MVC)", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelEasy:effort_conditionHigh_MVC", "Difficulty: Easy × Effort: High (40% MVC)", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelHard:effort_conditionLow_5_MVC", "Difficulty: Hard × Effort: Low (5% MVC)", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelHard:effort_conditionHigh_MVC", "Difficulty: Hard × Effort: High (40% MVC)", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelEasy:effort_conditionLow", "Difficulty: Easy × Effort: Low", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelEasy:effort_conditionHigh", "Difficulty: Easy × Effort: High", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelHard:effort_conditionLow", "Difficulty: Hard × Effort: Low", term)
    term <- gsub("difficulty_levelHard:effort_conditionHigh", "Difficulty: Hard × Effort: High", term)
    
    # Step 2: Handle main effects (only for terms NOT already processed as interactions)
    # Check if term is NOT already an interaction (doesn't contain ×)
    main_effect_mask <- !grepl(" × ", term)
    
    # Main effects (preserve colons - these separate factor name from level)
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("difficulty_levelEasy", "Difficulty: Easy", term[main_effect_mask])
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("difficulty_levelHard", "Difficulty: Hard", term[main_effect_mask])
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("effort_conditionLow_5_MVC", "Effort: Low", term[main_effect_mask])
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("effort_conditionHigh_MVC", "Effort: High", term[main_effect_mask])
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("effort_conditionLow", "Effort: Low", term[main_effect_mask])
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("effort_conditionHigh", "Effort: High", term[main_effect_mask])
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("taskVDT", "Task: VDT", term[main_effect_mask])
    term[main_effect_mask] <- gsub("taskADT", "Task: ADT", term[main_effect_mask])
    
    # Step 3: For any remaining raw R interactions (not caught above), convert colon to ×
    # Only if term still has raw R format colons (between factor names, not in cleaned format)
    raw_interaction_mask <- grepl("_condition|_level|task", term) & grepl(":", term) & !grepl(" × ", term)
    term[raw_interaction_mask] <- gsub(":", " × ", term[raw_interaction_mask])
    
    return(term)
  }
  
  rt_lmm %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
    mutate(
      term_clean = clean_term_name(term),
      estimate_fmt = sprintf("%.3f", estimate),
      ci_fmt = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", conf.low, conf.high)
    ) %>%
    select(term_clean, estimate_fmt, std.error, statistic, ci_fmt) %>%
    rename(term = term_clean) %>%
    gt() %>%
    cols_label(
      term = "Term",
      estimate_fmt = "Estimate (seconds)",
      std.error = "SE",
      ci_fmt = "95% CI"
    )
}
```

```{r}
    ) %>%
```

```{r}
lc_fiso_a_r <- if (!is.null(lc_stats$fiso_a_r)) sprintf("%.2f", lc_stats$fiso_a_r) else "—"
lc_fiso_a_p <- if (!is.null(lc_stats$fiso_a_p)) sprintf("%.3f", lc_stats$fiso_a_p) else "—"

```

LC MRI in a subset of participants ([@bennett2024lc]; overlapping BAP cohort). Exploratory only — not used for hypothesis tests or model selection.

**Sample.** `r lc_n_merged` participants had LC metrics and DDM random effects; `r lc_n_complete` had complete NODDI data. The LC subset did not differ from others on accuracy, RT, effort cost, or age (*p* > .19).

**Metrics.** LC CNR, NODDI fISO/fICVF, and composites (Composite~v2~, PC1~v2~). Outcomes: $d'$ variability and mean, |RT effort cost|, baseline DDM parameters (*v*, *a*, *z*), mean TEPR. Partial correlations controlled for age and sex.

**Results.** Higher LC fISO predicted greater $d'$ variability (partial *r* = `r lc_fiso_dprimevar_r`, *p* = `r lc_fiso_dprimevar_p`, *n* = `r lc_fiso_dprimevar_n`) but not mean $d'$ (*p* = `r lc_fiso_dprime_mean_p`). LC fISO correlated with lower baseline *a* (partial *r* = `r lc_fiso_a_r`, *p* = `r lc_fiso_a_p`); not with *v* (*p* = `r lc_fiso_v_p`), *z* (*p* > .80), or TEPR (*p* = `r lc_fiso_tepr_p`; CNR vs. TEPR: *p* = `r lc_cnr_tepr_p`).

@tbl-lc-exploratory-correlations lists targeted associations. @fig-lc-fiso-dprime-variability and @fig-lc-fiso-four-panel show the main patterns.

These results do not change the group-level effort → drift finding. They suggest LC free-water diffusion may relate to between-person variability in sensitivity and baseline caution.

## A10. Exploratory Temporal Dynamics {#app-exploratory-temporal .unnumbered}

These models evaluate choice history and within-run fatigue. They are reported here because they support interpretation of the main effort effects but do not directly test H1-H4 or the pupil-linked analysis.

### A10.1 Choice-history models {#sec-choice-history .unnumbered}

We fit two hierarchical Wiener DDM variants to test whether high somatic load increased reliance on recent responses (N = 17,199 trials after block-boundary exclusions; see Supplementary Methods). Both models added the previous response (coded ±0.5 for "Different"/"Same") to the starting-point bias subformula. The history model tested perseveration and its modulation by effort. The win-stay/lose-shift (WSLS) model also included previous-trial accuracy, asking whether carry-over differed after correct versus incorrect responses. The history model met the pre-specified $\hat{R} < 1.01$ criterion (max $\hat{R}$ = 1.003). The WSLS variant had a slightly elevated maximum $\hat{R}$ (1.014). Neither model had divergent transitions.

**Baseline perseveration.** Older adults showed a small but reliable tendency to repeat their previous response. In the history model, the previous-trial response coefficient on bias was positive with its 95% CrI excluding zero ($\hat{\beta}$ = 0.065, 95% CrI [0.005, 0.125], P($\beta$ > 0) = 98.2%). On the logit scale, this corresponds to approximately a 1.5 percentage-point shift in the probability of choosing "Different" following a "Different" response. The same direction and magnitude emerged in the WSLS model (0.137 [0.017, 0.256]).

**Effort does not amplify heuristic reliance.** The previous-trial response × effort interaction was near zero in both models: history model $\hat{\beta}$ = −0.001 (95% CrI [−0.065, 0.064], P($\beta$ > 0) = 48.8%); WSLS model −0.001 ([−0.065, 0.064]). Perseveration did not differ between High effort (40% MVC) and Low effort (5% MVC).

**Win-stay/lose-shift dynamics.** In the WSLS model, the interaction between previous-trial response and previous-trial accuracy was $\hat{\beta}$ = −0.107 (95% CrI [−0.225, 0.009], P($\beta$ > 0) = 3.6%). The CrI just includes zero. The direction indicates that the perseveration effect was larger after incorrect trials than after correct ones. Neither the main effect of previous accuracy on bias ($\hat{\beta}$ ≈ 0, CrI [−0.060, 0.059]) nor the effort contrast differed from zero.

**History effect on drift rate.** Previous-trial response also predicted current-trial drift rate in both models ($\hat{\beta}$ = 0.054 [0.008, 0.100], P($\beta$ > 0) = 99.1%). Drift was slightly higher when the current response direction matched the previous response.

The main estimates from both models are shown in @fig-temporal-dynamics (Panel C).

```{r choice-history-load}

#| echo: false

ch_wsls_rds  <- "output/publish/fit_exploratory_choice_history_wsls.rds"
ch_csv       <- "output/publish/exploratory_choice_history_posterior_summary.csv"

ch_fits_available <- file.exists(ch_hist_rds) && file.exists(ch_wsls_rds)

if (ch_fits_available) {
```

### A10.2 Within-session fatigue trajectory {#sec-fatigue-trajectory .unnumbered}

We also tested whether processing efficiency or caution changed within a run. A supplementary hierarchical Wiener DDM (N = 17,834 trials, 67 participants) included a within-run temporal factor. Each 30-trial run was split at the median trial position within each participant × task × run combination, producing first-half and second-half labels (maximum 1-trial imbalance across runs). The drift-rate subformula included effort, run half, continuous age (z-scored; 1 unit ≈ 6.4 years), and their three-way interaction. Boundary separation included effort, run half, and their interaction, with age as a main effect. The model converged satisfactorily (max $\hat{R}$ = 1.004; 0 divergent transitions).

**Within-run boundary relaxation.** The only parameter contrast with a 95% CrI excluding zero was the second-half change in boundary separation: $\hat{\beta}$ = −0.022 (95% CrI [−0.040, −0.004], P($\beta$ < 0) = 99.3%). On the exponentiated scale, this corresponds to a drop from about 2.04 to 1.99 across run halves under Low effort (5% MVC). The effort × run-half interaction was positive but non-credible ($\hat{\beta}$ = +0.011, 95% CrI [−0.014, 0.037]). Under High effort (40% MVC), the expected boundary in the second half (≈ 2.03) was close to the first-half value. Boundary trajectories for all four condition cells are shown in @fig-temporal-dynamics (Panel A).

**No credible drift-rate decline.** The effort × run-half interaction on drift was negative but spanned zero: $\hat{\beta}$ = −0.035 (95% CrI [−0.100, 0.032], P($\beta$ < 0) = 85.3%). Drift did not credibly decay in the second half of a run under High effort. The effort main effect on drift was directionally consistent with the primary model ($\hat{\beta}$ = −0.038, 95% CrI [−0.085, 0.008], P($\beta$ < 0) = 94.8%), but it was non-credible in this expanded model.

**Age does not moderate the trajectory.** The three-way interaction (effort × run half × age on drift) was $\hat{\beta}$ = −0.023 (95% CrI [−0.091, 0.044], P($\beta$ < 0) = 74.0%). The CrI spans zero, so there is no clear age gradient in within-run drift dynamics.

**Secondary pattern.** The run-half × age interaction on drift was positive and 95.8% probable ($\hat{\beta}$ = +0.048, 95% CrI [−0.006, 0.102]), with the CrI just including zero. Older-within-cohort participants tended to show slightly higher drift in the second half under Low effort. This pattern is exploratory.

The fatigue coefficients are plotted in @fig-temporal-dynamics (Panel B).

```{r fatigue-trajectory-load}
#| include: false
#| echo: false

fat_rds <- "output/publish/fit_exploratory_fatigue_trajectory.rds"
fat_csv <- "output/publish/exploratory_fatigue_trajectory_posterior_summary.csv"

fat_fit_available   <- file.exists(fat_rds)
fat_table_available <- file.exists(fat_csv)

if (fat_fit_available) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(brms))
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(posterior))
  fat_fit   <- readRDS(fat_rds)
  fat_draws <- as_draws_df(fat_fit)
}

if (fat_table_available) {
  fat_posterior_tbl <- read_csv(fat_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
      q2.5  = as.numeric(sub("[[](-?[0-9.]+),.*",      "\\1", CrI_95)),
      q97.5 = as.numeric(sub(".*,[ ]*(-?[0-9.]+)[]]",  "\\1", CrI_95))
    )
}
```

```{r fatigue-build-figure}
#| include: false
#| echo: false

p_fatigue_combined <- NULL

if (fat_fit_available && fat_table_available) {
  tryCatch({
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(dplyr))
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyr))
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(patchwork))

    # ── Panel A: coefficient forest plot ───────────────────────────────────────

    label_map <- c(
      "b_age_z"                                                    = "Age",
      "b_block_halfSecond_Half"                                    = "Block half: 2nd vs 1st",
      "b_block_halfSecond_Half:age_z"                             = "Block half x Age",
      "b_effort_conditionHigh_40_MVC"                             = "Effort: High vs Low",
      "b_effort_conditionHigh_40_MVC:age_z"                       = "Effort x Age",
      "b_effort_conditionHigh_40_MVC:block_halfSecond_Half"       = "Effort x Block half",
      "b_effort_conditionHigh_40_MVC:block_halfSecond_Half:age_z" = "Effort x Block half x Age",
      "b_bs_age_z"                                               = "Age",
      "b_bs_block_halfSecond_Half"                               = "Block half: 2nd vs 1st [*]",
      "b_bs_effort_conditionHigh_40_MVC"                        = "Effort: High vs Low",
      "b_bs_effort_conditionHigh_40_MVC:block_halfSecond_Half"  = "Effort x Block half"
    )

    fat_forest <- fat_posterior_tbl |>
      mutate(
        label          = label_map[parameter],
        parameter_type = factor(parameter_type, levels = c("Drift (v)", "Boundary (a)")),
        credible       = as.logical(excludes0)
      ) |>
      filter(!is.na(label)) |>
      group_by(parameter_type) |>
      arrange(parameter_type, median) |>
      ungroup() |>
      mutate(label = factor(label, levels = unique(label)))

    p_forest <- ggplot(fat_forest,
        aes(x = median, y = label, color = parameter_type)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
                 colour = "grey35", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = q2.5, xmax = q97.5),
                     height = 0.3, linewidth = 0.65, alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_point(aes(shape = credible, size = credible)) +
      scale_color_manual(values = fatigue_param_colors, guide = "none") +
      scale_shape_manual(
        values  = c("TRUE" = 16, "FALSE" = 21),
        labels  = c("TRUE" = "CrI excludes 0", "FALSE" = "CrI spans 0"),
        name    = NULL,
        guide   = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE, override.aes = list(size = 3))
      ) +
      scale_size_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 3.2, "FALSE" = 2.2), guide = "none") +
      facet_grid(parameter_type ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
      labs(
        x        = "Posterior estimate",
        y        = NULL,
        title    = NULL,
        subtitle = "Coefficient estimates"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9.5),
        panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position    = "none",
        axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 8.5),
        plot.subtitle      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 4))
      )

    # ── Panel B: expected boundary per cell ────────────────────────────────────

    bs_int  <- fat_draws[["Intercept_bs"]]
    bs_bh   <- fat_draws[["b_bs_block_halfSecond_Half"]]
    bs_eff  <- fat_draws[["b_bs_effort_conditionHigh_40_MVC"]]
    bs_intx <- fat_draws[["b_bs_effort_conditionHigh_40_MVC:block_halfSecond_Half"]]

    cell_draws <- tibble(
      `Low effort 1st half`   = exp(bs_int),
      `Low effort 2nd half`   = exp(bs_int + bs_bh),
      `High effort 1st half`  = exp(bs_int + bs_eff),
      `High effort 2nd half`  = exp(bs_int + bs_eff + bs_bh + bs_intx)
    ) |>
      pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "cell", values_to = "boundary")

    cell_summary <- cell_draws |>
      group_by(cell) |>
      summarise(
        med  = median(boundary),
        lo   = quantile(boundary, .025),
        hi   = quantile(boundary, .975),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      mutate(
        effort = if_else(grepl("High", cell), "High effort (40% MVC)", "Low effort (5% MVC)"),
        half   = if_else(grepl("1st", cell), "1st Half", "2nd Half"),
        half   = factor(half, levels = c("1st Half", "2nd Half"))
      )

    p_boundary <- ggplot(cell_summary,
        aes(x = half, y = med, colour = effort, group = effort)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = effort, group = effort),
                  alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                    width = 0.08, linewidth = 0.6) +
      geom_point(size = 3.5) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = fatigue_effort_colors,
        name   = NULL,
        guide  = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE, override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.2))
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = fatigue_effort_colors, guide = "none") +
      labs(
        x        = "Session half",
        y        = "Boundary separation (exp scale)",
        title    = NULL,
        subtitle = "Boundary trajectories"
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1.88, 2.20)) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position    = "bottom",
        axis.title         = element_text(size = 8.5),
        plot.subtitle      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 4))
      )

    p_fatigue_combined <- p_forest + p_boundary +
      plot_layout(
        widths    = c(1.55, 1),
        guides    = "collect",
        tag_level = "new"
      ) +
      plot_annotation(
        caption = "Filled circles: 95% CrI excludes zero. Open circles: CrI spans zero.",
        theme   = theme(
          plot.caption   = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey30", hjust = 0),
          plot.tag       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
          plot.tag.position = c(0.01, 0.98)
        )
      ) &
      theme(
        legend.position    = "bottom",
        legend.box         = "horizontal",
        legend.box.just    = "left",
        legend.spacing.x   = unit(0.6, "cm"),
        legend.margin      = margin(t = 6, b = 2),
        legend.text        = element_text(size = 8.5),
        plot.margin        = margin(8, 8, 4, 8)
      )

  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Fatigue trajectory figure build failed: ", e$message)
  })
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-temporal-dynamics
#| fig-cap: "**Effort degraded evidence quality upstream but did not amplify heuristic responding or produce within-run accumulation-stage exhaustion; the only credible temporal effect was a modest boundary relaxation across run halves.** **(A)** Population-average boundary separation ($a$, exponentiated scale) across the first and second halves of each 30-trial run, by effort condition (95% CrI). **(B)** Focal coefficients from the within-run fatigue model; only the 2nd-vs-1st-half boundary decline (marked *) has a 95% CrI excluding zero; the effort $\\times$ run-half interaction on $a$ and the effort $\\times$ run-half interaction on $v$ both span zero. **(C)** Posterior distributions of the perseveration-on-bias coefficient and the effort $\\times$ previous-response interaction on bias, from the history model (teal) and WSLS model (gold), plotted on the logit scale. Statistical note: Boundary decline, 2nd vs. 1st half: $\\hat{\\beta} = -0.022$, 95% CrI [$-0.040$, $-0.004$], $P(\\beta < 0) = 99.3$%. Effort $\\times$ run-half on boundary: $\\hat{\\beta} = +0.011$ [$-0.014$, $0.037$]. Effort $\\times$ previous-response on bias: $\\hat{\\beta} = -0.001$ [$-0.065$, $0.064$]. Perseveration on bias: $\\hat{\\beta} = 0.065$ [$0.005$, $0.125$], $P(\\beta > 0) = 98.2$%."
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-pos: "H"
#| out-width: "100%"
include_graphics_safe(main_fig("fig4_temporal_dynamics.png"))
```
